source.text: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־יְהוָ֛ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ עָצ֔וּר בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And came [the] word of Yahweh to Jeremiah a second [time], and he still [was] shut up in [the] courtyard of the guard, saying:

en.L: And the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Jeremiah a second time, while he [was] still shut up in the courtyard of the guard, saying:
en.B: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still held in the courtyard of the guard:
en.R: Jeremiah was still locked up in the courtyard of the guard. While he was there, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave him a second message:

es.L: Y vino la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a Jeremías por segunda vez, estando él todavía encerrado en el patio de la guardia, diciendo:
es.B: La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Jeremías por segunda vez, mientras todavía estaba detenido en el patio de la guardia:
es.R: Jeremías seguía encerrado en el patio de la guardia. Mientras estaba allí, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio un segundo mensaje:

fr.L: Et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Jérémie une seconde fois, alors qu’il [était] encore enfermé dans la cour de la garde, disant :
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Jérémie une seconde fois, alors qu’il était encore détenu dans la cour de la garde :
fr.R: Jérémie était toujours enfermé dans la cour de la garde. Pendant qu’il était là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a donné un deuxième message :

sw.L: Na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likamjia Yeremia mara ya pili, alipokuwa angali amefungwa katika ua wa walinzi, kusema:
sw.B: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilimjia Yeremia mara ya pili, alipokuwa bado amezuiliwa katika ua wa walinzi:
sw.R: Yeremia alikuwa bado amefungiwa katika ua wa walinzi. Alipokuwa huko, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa ujumbe wa pili:

vi.L: Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi lần thứ hai, trong khi ông còn bị giam trong sân lính canh, rằng:
vi.B: Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi lần thứ hai, trong khi ông vẫn còn bị giam trong sân lính canh:
vi.R: Giê-rê-mi vẫn còn bị nhốt trong sân lính canh. Trong khi ông ở đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho ông sứ điệp thứ hai:

ko.L: 그리고 예레미야가 아직 경비대 뜰에 갇혀 있을 때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 두 번째로 그에게 임하여 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 예레미야가 아직 경비대 뜰에 갇혀 있을 때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 두 번째로 그에게 임했다.
ko.R: 예레미야는 아직 경비대 뜰에 갇혀 있었다. 그가 거기에 있을 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 두 번째 말씀을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: a second time: a second word in the same setting as chapter 32
decisions.reason: The first word came while Jeremiah was held in the courtyard of the guard during the siege (32:1-2, 6, 26). This second word comes while he is still there, and it carries on the promises of 32:36-44 that the city and land will be restored.

decisions.choice: shut up in the courtyard of the guard: held under watch within the palace
decisions.reason: As in 32:2, where the place is explained: a guarded court in the royal palace where Jeremiah was confined but could still receive visitors and speak (32:8, 12; 37:21; 38:28).

decisions.choice: courtyard of the guard (all levels); shut up (L), held (B), locked up (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 32:2 at each level. Readable puts the setting first and says "gave him a second message" for "the word came", following the wording set for this formula in Jeremiah.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עֹשָׂ֑הּ יְהוָ֗ה יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֛הּ לַהֲכִינָ֖הּ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh [who] made it, Yahweh who formed it to establish it, Yahweh [is] his name:

en.L: "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who made it, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who formed it to establish it, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name:
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who made it, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who formed it and set it firm; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name:
en.R: "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made it, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shaped it and made it stand firm. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. He says:

es.L: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que lo hizo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que lo formó para afirmarlo; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre:
es.B: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que lo hizo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que lo formó y lo afirmó; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre:
es.R: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo hizo, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le dio forma y lo hizo estar firme. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Él dice:

fr.L: « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a fait, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a formé pour l’affermir, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom :
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a fait, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a façonné et l’a rendu stable ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom :
fr.R: « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a fait, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a façonné et l’a rendu solide. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Il dit :

sw.L: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi, aliyeifanya, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyeiumba ili kuithibitisha, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}:
sw.B: "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyeifanya, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyeiumba na kuisimamisha imara; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}:
sw.R: "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliifanya, naye aliiumba na kuisimamisha imara. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Anasema:

vi.L: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này, Đấng làm nên điều ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đấng đã nắn nên điều ấy để lập nó vững bền, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}:
vi.B: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng làm nên điều ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng đã nắn nên và lập nó vững bền; danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}:
vi.R: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm nên điều ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên và làm cho nó đứng vững. Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ngài phán:

ko.L: "그것을 만드신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그것을 빚어 세우신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그 이름이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 분께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다.
ko.B: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 그것을 만드신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그것을 빚어 굳게 세우신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그 이름이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 분께서 말씀하신다.
ko.R: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그것을 만들었다. 그것을 빚어 굳게 서게 했다. 내 이름은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. 내가 말한다.

decisions.choice: it: the Hebrew names no object for what the LORD made, formed and established
decisions.reason: The three verbs each have "it" (a feminine pronoun) with no noun to point back to. It may mean the earth, which the LORD made and set firm (10:12; 51:15); the Septuagint has "the earth" here. Or it may mean what the LORD plans and then carries out, as when he says of the fall of cities, "I formed it ... now I have brought it about" (Isaiah 37:26). The Hebrew is kept as it stands, with "it".

decisions.choice: formed: shaped, as a potter shapes clay; establish: make firm so that it stands
decisions.reason: The verb "form" is the potter's word (18:4-6; Genesis 2:7). "Establish" means to set something firmly in place so that it lasts.

decisions.choice: the LORD is his name: a phrase from Israel's hymns
decisions.reason: The words close the praise of God as Creator in Amos 5:8 and 9:6 and are sung in Exodus 15:3. Jeremiah uses the longer form "the LORD of hosts is his name" in 10:16 and 31:35. The God who speaks is the one whose word made the world.

decisions.choice: short sentences; "it" kept
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the titles into short sentences but keeps "it" unexplained, because the Hebrew does not say what "it" is (m1).

decisions.choice: lo hizo, lo formó (object left unnamed)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names no object for what the LORD made and formed (meaning decision m1), so every level keeps the bare "lo", as the English keeps "it".

decisions.choice: "l'" with no named object at every level
decisions.reason: As the English: the Hebrew does not say what the LORD made, formed and established (meaning decision m1), so French keeps the bare pronoun.

decisions.choice: "điều ấy" (it); "nắn nên" (formed)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names no object (meaning decision m1), so every level keeps an open "điều ấy". "Nắn" is the potter's verb of 18:4-11, as meaning decision m2 notes.

decisions.choice: "만드신 ... 분께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L, B), "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다" (R), with the honorific
decisions.reason: One rule for Isaiah, Jeremiah and Ezra: the messenger formula keeps the honorific even where God dictates the message, as published at 1 Kings 21:19, 2 Samuel 7:5 and 1 Chronicles 17:4; God's own words that follow stay in the plain style, without -시- for himself. Readable then lets God speak in the first person ("내 이름은"), so young readers see that God himself is speaking.

decisions.choice: "그것을" kept without saying what "it" is
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names no object (meaning decision m1); Korean keeps the open "그것", as the English keeps "it".

source.text: קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Call to me and I will answer you, and I will tell to you great [things] and inaccessible [things] [which] not you have known them.

en.L: Call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will answer you, and I will tell you great [things] and inaccessible [things] that you have not known.
en.B: Call out to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will answer you. I will make known to you great things, things beyond your reach, which you have not known.
en.R: Call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will answer you. I will tell you about great things that are out of your reach, things you do not know.

es.L: Clama a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo te responderé, y te anunciaré cosas grandes e inaccesibles que tú no conoces.
es.B: Clama a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo te responderé. Te daré a conocer cosas grandes, cosas fuera de tu alcance, que no conoces.
es.R: Llámame, y yo te responderé. Te contaré cosas grandes que están fuera de tu alcance, cosas que no sabes.

fr.L: Appelle-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je te répondrai, et je t’annoncerai des choses grandes et inaccessibles que tu ne connais pas.
fr.B: Crie vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je te répondrai. Je te ferai connaître de grandes choses, des choses hors de ta portée, que tu ne connais pas.
fr.R: Appelle-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je te répondrai. Je te parlerai de grandes choses qui sont hors de ta portée, des choses que tu ne connais pas.

sw.L: Niite, nami nitakuitikia, nami nitakuambia mambo makuu na [mambo] yasiyofikika usiyoyajua.
sw.B: Niite, nami nitakujibu. Nitakujulisha mambo makuu, mambo yaliyo nje ya uwezo wako, ambayo hukuyajua.
sw.R: Niite, nami nitakujibu. Nitakuambia mambo makuu yaliyo mbali na uwezo wako, mambo usiyoyajua.

vi.L: Hãy kêu cầu Ta, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trả lời ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tỏ cho ngươi những [điều] lớn lao và những [điều] khó thấu mà ngươi chưa biết.
vi.B: Hãy kêu cầu Ta, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trả lời con. Ta sẽ tỏ cho con những điều lớn lao, những điều ngoài tầm hiểu biết của con, là những điều con chưa hề biết.
vi.R: Hãy kêu cầu Ta, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trả lời con. Ta sẽ nói cho con biết những điều lớn lao vượt quá sự hiểu biết của con, những điều con chưa biết.

ko.L: 나를 불러라. 그러면 내가 너에게 대답하고, 네가 알지 못하는 크고 비밀한 [일들]을 너에게 알려 주겠다.
ko.B: 나를 불러라. 그러면 내가 너에게 대답하겠다. 네가 알지 못하는 크고 놀라운 일들, 네 힘으로는 알 수 없는 일들을 너에게 알려 주겠다.
ko.R: 나를 불러라. 그러면 내가 너에게 대답하겠다. 네가 알 수 없는 크고 놀라운 일들, 네가 모르는 일들을 너에게 알려 주겠다.

decisions.choice: inaccessible things: things fenced off, out of human reach
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for cities with high walls that no one can get into (Numbers 13:28; Deuteronomy 3:5). Said of things, it means matters closed off from human knowing until God opens them. A few Hebrew manuscripts have a word that differs by one letter, "guarded" or "hidden things", the word used in Isaiah 48:6 for new things God has kept back; the sense is close either way. The Septuagint has "strong things", a reading of the same consonants as "fortified". The usual Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: you: one person, Jeremiah himself
decisions.reason: "Call" and every "you" in this verse are singular. The LORD speaks to the prophet in prison: if he prays, God will answer him and show him what no one could know.

decisions.choice: call and I will answer: the promise that God hears prayer
decisions.reason: The pairing of call and answer is a promise found in Psalm 91:15 and Isaiah 58:9. Here it is an invitation: what God is about to say of the city's future is beyond what anyone in the siege could see.

decisions.choice: great things, things out of reach
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the picture of the word (m1) in plain terms rather than the more general "hidden". Literal says "inaccessible".

decisions.choice: "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R) to Jeremiah
decisions.reason: The "you" here is Jeremiah alone (meaning decision m2), so God addresses him as in 18:2.

decisions.choice: "비밀한 일들" (L); "네 힘으로는 알 수 없는 일들" (B); "네가 알 수 없는 일들" (R)
decisions.reason: Things fenced off, out of human reach (meaning decision m1); Korean says what that means at each level.

source.text: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־בָּתֵּי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְעַל־בָּתֵּ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה הַנְּתֻצִ֕ים אֶל־הַסֹּלְל֖וֹת וְאֶל־הֶחָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh [the] God of Israel concerning [the] houses of the city the this and concerning [the] houses of [the] kings of Judah, the [ones] torn down against the siege ramps and against the sword:

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah that are torn down against the siege ramps and against the sword:
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says this about the houses of this city and the houses of the kings of Judah, which have been torn down to hold back the siege ramps and the sword:
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says. He speaks about the houses in this city and the houses of Judah's kings. They have been torn down to make the defenses stronger against the enemy's ramps and swords.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, acerca de las casas de esta ciudad y acerca de las casas de los reyes de Judá, derribadas contra los terraplenes y contra la espada:
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, dice esto acerca de las casas de esta ciudad y de las casas de los reyes de Judá, que han sido derribadas para hacer frente a los terraplenes de asedio y a la espada:
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel. Habla de las casas de esta ciudad y de las casas de los reyes de Judá. Las han derribado para reforzar las defensas contra las rampas y las espadas del enemigo.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, au sujet des maisons de cette ville et au sujet des maisons des rois de Juda qui sont démolies contre les remblais et contre l’épée :
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci au sujet des maisons de cette ville et des maisons des rois de Juda, qu’on a démolies pour résister aux remblais de siège et à l’épée :
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. Il parle des maisons de cette ville et des maisons des rois de Juda. On les a démolies pour renforcer les défenses contre les rampes et les épées de l’ennemi.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi kuhusu nyumba za mji huu, na kuhusu nyumba za wafalme wa Yuda, zilizobomolewa kwa ajili ya maboma ya kuzingira na kwa ajili ya upanga:
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo kuhusu nyumba za mji huu na nyumba za wafalme wa Yuda, zilizobomolewa ili kuyazuia maboma ya kuzingira na upanga:
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema. Anasema kuhusu nyumba za mji huu na nyumba za wafalme wa Yuda. Zimebomolewa ili kuimarisha ngome dhidi ya maboma na panga za adui.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này về các nhà trong thành này và các cung của các vua Giu-đa đã bị phá đổ để chống lại các ụ đất vây hãm và lưỡi gươm:
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy về nhà cửa trong thành này và cung điện của các vua Giu-đa, là những nhà đã bị phá đổ để chặn các ụ đất vây hãm và lưỡi gươm:
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán. Ngài phán về nhà cửa trong thành này và cung điện của các vua Giu-đa. Người ta đã phá những nhà ấy để lấy vật liệu củng cố tường thành chống lại các ụ đất và gươm giáo của quân thù.

ko.L: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서, 흙 언덕과 칼을 막으려고 헐어 낸 이 성의 집들과 유다 왕들의 집들에 대하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서, 적의 흙 언덕과 칼을 막으려고 헐어 버린 이 성의 집들과 유다 왕들의 집들에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하신다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 이 성의 집들과 유다 왕들의 집들에 대하여 말한다. 사람들은 적의 흙 언덕과 칼을 막으려고 성벽을 튼튼히 하느라 그 집들을 헐어 버렸다.

decisions.choice: houses torn down: buildings pulled apart to strengthen the city's defenses
decisions.reason: During a siege the defenders took down houses near the wall and used their stones and timber to make it thicker and higher. Isaiah 22:10 describes the same thing in an earlier siege of Jerusalem. Even the royal houses were sacrificed.

decisions.choice: against the siege ramps and against the sword: torn down to stand against the enemy's ramps and weapons
alternatives: torn down by the siege ramps and the sword
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only that the houses were torn down "against" the ramps and the sword. Most naturally the houses were taken apart to build defenses against the attack. It could also mean that they were broken down by the ramps and weapons of the attackers. Either way the ruined houses stand for a city that is losing the fight.

decisions.choice: siege ramps: mounds of earth heaped against a wall
decisions.reason: Attackers built ramps up to a city wall so that soldiers and battering rams could reach the top (6:6; 32:24; Isaiah 37:33).

decisions.choice: to hold back (B); to make the defenses stronger (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say why the houses were torn down, following m2. Literal keeps the bare "against". Readable also adds "enemy's" to make clear whose ramps and swords they are.

source.text: בָּאִ֗ים לְהִלָּחֵם֙ אֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּלְמַלְאָם֙ אֶת־פִּגְרֵ֣י הָאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הִכֵּ֥יתִי בְאַפִּ֖י וּבַחֲמָתִ֑י וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הִסְתַּ֤רְתִּי פָנַי֙ מֵהָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את עַ֖ל כָּל־רָעָתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [They are] coming to fight with the Chaldeans and to fill them [with] corpses of the human [beings] whom I have struck down in my anger and in my wrath, and [as] I have hidden my face from the city the this because of all their evil.

en.L: [They are] coming to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the corpses of the people whom I have struck down in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath, and [as] I have hidden {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face from this city because of all their evil.
en.B: They come to fight against the Chaldeans, but only to fill these houses with the dead bodies of the people I have struck down in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rage; for I have hidden {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face from this city because of all their evil.
en.R: Men are going out to fight the Babylonians. But they will only fill these houses with the dead bodies of the people I have struck down because I am so angry. I have turned away from this city because of all the evil its people have done.

es.L: [Vienen] a pelear contra los caldeos, y a llenarlas de cadáveres de hombres a quienes he herido en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, [pues] he escondido {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro de esta ciudad a causa de toda su maldad.
es.B: Salen a pelear contra los caldeos, pero solo para llenar estas casas de los cadáveres de la gente que he herido en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor; porque he escondido {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro de esta ciudad a causa de toda su maldad.
es.R: Los hombres salen a pelear contra los babilonios. Pero solo llenarán estas casas con los cadáveres de la gente a la que he herido de muerte porque estoy muy enojado. Me he apartado de esta ciudad por todo el mal que ha hecho su gente.

fr.L: [On] vient combattre les Chaldéens, et [c’est] pour les remplir des cadavres des hommes que j’ai frappés dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur, et [parce que] j’ai caché {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face à cette ville à cause de toute leur méchanceté.
fr.B: On vient combattre les Chaldéens, mais seulement pour remplir ces maisons des cadavres des gens que j’ai frappés dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur ; car j’ai caché {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face à cette ville à cause de toute sa méchanceté.
fr.R: Des hommes sortent pour combattre les Babyloniens. Mais ils ne feront que remplir ces maisons des cadavres des gens que j’ai frappés, parce que je suis très en colère. Je me suis détourné de cette ville à cause de tout le mal que ses habitants ont fait.

sw.L: [Wanakuja] kupigana na Wakaldayo, na kuzijaza mizoga ya watu ambao nimewaua katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, [kwa kuwa] nimeuficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mbali na mji huu kwa sababu ya uovu wao wote.
sw.B: Wanakuja kupigana na Wakaldayo, lakini ni kuzijaza nyumba hizi tu maiti za watu niliowaua katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; kwa maana nimeuficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mbali na mji huu kwa sababu ya uovu wao wote.
sw.R: Wanaume wanatoka kwenda kupigana na Wababeli. Lakini watazijaza nyumba hizi tu maiti za watu ambao nimewaua kwa sababu nimekasirika sana. Nimeugeuzia mji huu kisogo kwa sababu ya maovu yote ambayo watu wake wameyatenda.

vi.L: [Chúng] đến để đánh với người Canh-đê, và để làm cho các nhà ấy đầy xác những người mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đánh giết trong cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ của Ta, [vì] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ẩn mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi thành này vì mọi điều ác của chúng.
vi.B: Chúng đến để đánh nhau với người Canh-đê, nhưng chỉ làm cho các nhà ấy đầy xác những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đánh giết trong cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ của Ta, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ẩn mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi thành này vì mọi điều gian ác của chúng.
vi.R: Người ta đang ra đánh quân Ba-by-lôn. Nhưng họ chỉ làm cho các nhà ấy đầy xác những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đánh giết vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rất giận. Ta đã quay mặt khỏi thành này vì mọi điều ác dân thành đã làm.

ko.L: [그들이] 갈대아 사람들과 싸우러 오지만, 내가 내 진노와 분노로 쳐 죽인 사람들의 시체로 그것들을 채우게 될 것이다. 그들의 모든 악 때문에 내가 이 성에서 내 얼굴을 숨겼다.
ko.B: 그들이 갈대아 사람들과 싸우러 나가지만, 내가 진노와 분노로 쳐 죽인 사람들의 시체로 이 집들을 채울 뿐이다. 그들의 모든 악 때문에 내가 이 성에서 얼굴을 숨겼기 때문이다.
ko.R: 사람들이 바빌로니아 사람들과 싸우러 나가고 있다. 그러나 그들은 내가 몹시 노하여 쳐 죽인 사람들의 시체로 이 집들을 채우게 될 뿐이다. 이 성의 백성이 저지른 온갖 악 때문에 내가 이 성에서 등을 돌렸다.

decisions.choice: coming to fight the Chaldeans: the defenders go out against the Babylonians
alternatives: the Chaldeans are coming to fight
decisions.reason: The verse begins with a bare "coming", with no subject. Most likely it means the men of Jerusalem who go to fight the Chaldeans, and the result is only more dead. The Hebrew sentence is hard, and some read it as the Chaldeans coming to fight against the city. The text is kept as it stands.

decisions.choice: to fill them: to fill the houses of verse 4 with the dead
decisions.reason: "Them" points back to the houses. The houses taken apart for the defense will be filled with the bodies of those who die in the fighting.

decisions.choice: I have hidden my face: I have turned away and will not help
decisions.reason: To hide the face is to withdraw favor and protection (Deuteronomy 31:17-18; Isaiah 8:17; 54:8). The city is left to its enemies because of its evil.

decisions.choice: and whom ... and as I have hidden: the small word links the hiding of God's face to the slaughter
decisions.reason: The word usually means "which" or "whom". Here it is best taken as giving the reason or the setting: the people die because God has hidden his face from the city.

decisions.choice: but only to fill (B); But they will only fill (R); these houses
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out that the fighting achieves nothing but more dead, and say that "them" means the houses (m2).

decisions.choice: he escondido mi rostro
decisions.reason: God hiding his face means turning away and refusing help (meaning decision m3); Literal and Balanced keep the image, Readable says "me he apartado".

decisions.choice: "ẩn mặt Ta" (hidden my face)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture, which Vietnamese readers know from the Psalms; Readable says "quay mặt" (turned away), as meaning decision m3 explains.

decisions.choice: "얼굴을 숨기다" (L, B); "등을 돌리다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture; Readable says what it means (meaning decision m3).

source.text: הִנְנִ֧י מַעֲלֶה־לָּ֛הּ אֲרֻכָ֥ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א וּרְפָאתִ֑ים וְגִלֵּיתִ֣י לָהֶ֔ם עֲתֶ֥רֶת שָׁל֖וֹם וֶאֱמֶֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Here I [am] bringing up to it healing and cure, and I will heal them; and I will reveal to them an abundance of peace and stability.

en.L: Look, I am going to bring up for it healing and cure, and I will heal them; and I will reveal to them an abundance of peace and stability.
en.B: But look, I will bring this city recovery and a cure. I will heal its people and show them peace and stability in abundance.
en.R: But I will make this city well again. I will heal its people, and I will let them enjoy peace and safety in plenty.

es.L: He aquí, yo le traeré sanidad y medicina, y los sanaré; y les revelaré abundancia de paz y de estabilidad.
es.B: Pero yo le traeré a esta ciudad salud y curación. Sanaré a su gente y le mostraré paz y seguridad en abundancia.
es.R: Pero haré que esta ciudad vuelva a estar sana. Sanaré a su gente, y dejaré que disfruten de paz y seguridad en abundancia.

fr.L: Voici, je vais faire monter pour elle la guérison et la santé, et je les guérirai ; et je leur révélerai une abondance de paix et de stabilité.
fr.B: Mais je vais apporter à cette ville le rétablissement et la guérison. Je guérirai ses habitants et je leur ferai voir la paix et la sécurité en abondance.
fr.R: Mais je rendrai la santé à cette ville. Je guérirai ses habitants, et je leur donnerai la paix et la sécurité en abondance.

sw.L: Tazama, nitauletea uponyaji na dawa, nami nitawaponya; nami nitawafunulia wingi wa amani na uthabiti.
sw.B: Lakini tazama, nitauletea mji huu kupona na dawa. Nitawaponya watu wake na kuwaonyesha amani na uthabiti tele.
sw.R: Lakini nitaufanya mji huu kuwa mzima tena. Nitawaponya watu wake, nami nitawaacha wafurahie amani na usalama tele.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem đến cho nó sự lành bệnh và thuốc chữa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chữa lành chúng; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tỏ cho chúng sự dư dật bình an và sự vững bền.
vi.B: Nhưng kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem lại cho thành này sự phục hồi và chữa lành. Ta sẽ chữa lành dân thành và tỏ cho họ sự bình an và an ổn dư dật.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho thành này lành mạnh trở lại. Ta sẽ chữa lành dân thành, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho họ hưởng bình an và an toàn đầy đủ.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 이 성에 치료와 회복을 가져오고, 그들을 고쳐 주겠다. 그리고 그들에게 풍성한 평안과 안정을 드러내 보이겠다.
ko.B: 그러나 보아라, 내가 이 성을 회복시키고 고쳐 주겠다. 내가 이 성의 백성을 치료하고, 그들에게 넘치는 평안과 안정을 보여 주겠다.
ko.R: 그러나 내가 이 성을 다시 낫게 하겠다. 내가 이 성의 백성을 고쳐 주고, 그들이 평안과 안전을 넉넉히 누리게 하겠다.

decisions.choice: I am going to bring up healing: the answer to the question of 8:22
decisions.reason: In 8:22 Jeremiah asked why the healing of his people had not "come up". The same words, the verb and the noun, return here: now God himself will bring the healing up. The word means new flesh growing over a wound, and so recovery (30:17; Isaiah 58:8).

decisions.choice: abundance: a rare word, a wealth or plenty
decisions.reason: The noun occurs only here. It comes from a verb meaning to be plentiful, and most take it as abundance. The sense of the line is clear: God will show his people peace in full measure.

decisions.choice: peace and stability: well-being that lasts
decisions.reason: The second word is the one that means faithfulness or truth. With "peace" it means firmness and security, as in Isaiah 39:8, where the same pair of words is used. The false prophets had promised "true peace" (14:13); now God gives it.

decisions.choice: this city, its people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whom "it" (the city) and "them" (its people) refer to.

source.text: וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִי֙ אֶת־שְׁב֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת שְׁב֣וּת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְנִתִ֖ים כְּבָרִֽאשֹׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will turn back [the] fortunes of Judah and [the] fortunes of Israel, and I will build them as at the first.

en.L: And I will restore the fortunes of Judah and the fortunes of Israel, and I will build them as at the first.
en.B: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and of Israel, and I will rebuild them as they were at the beginning.
en.R: I will make things good again for Judah and for Israel. I will build them up again, as they were before.

es.L: Y restauraré la suerte de Judá y la suerte de Israel, y los edificaré como al principio.
es.B: Restauraré la suerte de Judá y de Israel, y los reedificaré como eran al principio.
es.R: Haré que todo vuelva a ir bien para Judá y para Israel. Los volveré a edificar, como eran antes.

fr.L: Et je rétablirai le sort de Juda et le sort d’Israël, et je les bâtirai comme au commencement.
fr.B: Je rétablirai le sort de Juda et d’Israël, et je les rebâtirai comme ils étaient au début.
fr.R: Je rendrai de nouveau heureux Juda et Israël. Je les reconstruirai, comme ils étaient autrefois.

sw.L: Nami nitawarudishia mafanikio Yuda na mafanikio Israeli, nami nitawajenga kama hapo kwanza.
sw.B: Nitawarudishia mafanikio Yuda na Israeli, nami nitawajenga upya kama walivyokuwa mwanzoni.
sw.R: Nitayafanya mambo kuwa mema tena kwa Yuda na kwa Israeli. Nitawajenga tena, wawe kama walivyokuwa zamani.

vi.L: Ta sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của Giu-đa và cơ đồ của Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xây dựng họ như lúc ban đầu.
vi.B: Ta sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của Giu-đa và Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xây dựng lại họ như thuở ban đầu.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại cho Giu-đa và Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ta sẽ xây dựng họ lại như trước kia.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 유다의 운명과 이스라엘의 운명을 돌이키고, 그들을 처음과 같이 세우겠다.
ko.B: 내가 유다와 이스라엘의 형편을 회복시키고, 그들을 처음처럼 다시 세우겠다.
ko.R: 내가 유다와 이스라엘을 다시 잘되게 해 주겠다. 그들을 전처럼 다시 세우겠다.

decisions.choice: restore the fortunes: turn the people's ruin around
decisions.reason: The phrase repeats one root: "turn the turning". It means a full change from ruin back to well-being (Deuteronomy 30:3; Job 42:10). Some take the noun as "captivity", "bring back the captives", which suits the exile; the promise of rebuilding follows either way. Jeremiah uses the phrase again in 33:11 and 33:26, and in 29:14, 30:3 and 32:44.

decisions.choice: Judah and Israel: both kingdoms, south and north
decisions.reason: The northern kingdom, Israel, had gone into exile long before (2 Kings 17). The promise takes in the whole nation again, as in 23:6 and 30:3.

decisions.choice: I will build them: the building promised at Jeremiah's call
decisions.reason: God made Jeremiah his messenger "to build and to plant" as well as to tear down (1:10). The promise to build the people up again returns in 24:6 and 31:4, 28.

decisions.choice: make things good again
decisions.reason: Readable says what "restore the fortunes" means in plain words, as Deuteronomy 30:3 does.

decisions.choice: "운명을 돌이키다" (L); "형편을 회복시키다" (B); "다시 잘되게 해 주다" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set at 29:14 for *shuv shevut* (meaning decision m1).

source.text: וְטִ֣הַרְתִּ֔ים מִכָּל־עֲוֺנָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ־לִ֑י וְסָלַחְתִּ֗י לְכָל־עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ־לִ֔י וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity which they have sinned against me, and I will forgive all their iniquities which they have sinned against me and which they have rebelled against me.

en.L: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will forgive all their iniquities by which they have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and by which they have rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: I will cleanse them from all the guilt of their sin against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will forgive all their guilt, every way they have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: I will wash away all the sins they have done against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I will forgive all their sins and every way they have turned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y los limpiaré de toda la iniquidad con que pecaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y perdonaré todas las iniquidades con que pecaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y con que se rebelaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Los limpiaré de toda la culpa de su pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y perdonaré todas sus culpas, cada una de las maneras en que pecaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y se rebelaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: Lavaré todos los pecados que cometieron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Perdonaré todos sus pecados y todas las veces que se pusieron en contra de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Et je les purifierai de toute leur iniquité par laquelle ils ont péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je pardonnerai toutes leurs iniquités par lesquelles ils ont péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et par lesquelles ils se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Je les purifierai de toute la faute de leur péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je pardonnerai toutes leurs fautes, toutes les manières dont ils ont péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: J’effacerai tous les péchés qu’ils ont commis contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je pardonnerai tous leurs péchés et toutes les fois où ils se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Nami nitawatakasa na uovu wao wote waliokosa juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, nami nitawasamehe maovu yao yote waliyonikosea na ambayo kwayo wameniasi.
sw.B: Nitawatakasa na hatia yote ya dhambi yao dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, nami nitawasamehe hatia yao yote, kila njia waliyonikosea na kuniasi.
sw.R: Nitaziosha dhambi zote walizonitendea. Nitawasamehe dhambi zao zote na kila njia waliyoniasi.

vi.L: Ta sẽ tẩy sạch họ khỏi mọi tội ác mà họ đã phạm nghịch cùng Ta, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ mọi tội ác mà họ đã phạm nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và đã phản nghịch cùng Ta.
vi.B: Ta sẽ tẩy sạch họ khỏi mọi tội lỗi họ đã phạm nghịch cùng Ta, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ mọi tội ác của họ, mọi điều họ đã phạm và phản nghịch cùng Ta.
vi.R: Ta sẽ rửa sạch mọi tội lỗi họ đã phạm nghịch cùng Ta. Ta sẽ tha thứ mọi tội lỗi của họ và mọi điều họ đã làm để chống lại Ta.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그들이 나에게 지은 모든 죄악에서 그들을 깨끗하게 하고, 그들이 나에게 죄를 짓고 나를 거역한 모든 죄악을 용서하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 그들이 나에게 지은 모든 죄의 허물을 깨끗이 씻어 주고, 그들이 나에게 죄를 짓고 나를 거역한 모든 허물을 용서하겠다.
ko.R: 내가 그들이 나에게 지은 모든 죄를 깨끗이 씻어 주겠다. 내가 그들의 모든 죄를 용서하고, 그들이 나에게 등을 돌린 모든 일을 용서하겠다.

decisions.choice: iniquity, sin, rebellion: every kind of wrong
decisions.reason: Three words for wrongdoing are piled up: iniquity (the guilt of crooked deeds), sin (missing the mark) and rebellion (breaking away from one's master). Together they say that nothing the people have done is left out of the cleansing and forgiveness.

decisions.choice: cleanse and forgive: the promise of the new covenant
decisions.reason: In 31:34 God promised, "I will forgive their iniquity and remember their sin no more." Here forgiveness is joined with cleansing, the washing away of what made the people unclean before God (2:22; 13:27).

decisions.choice: all: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text spells the word for "all" slightly differently from the form the scribes noted in the margin to be read aloud. The meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: iniquity (L); guilt (B); sins (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "iniquity"; Balanced says "guilt" and Readable "sins", the wording set for this word in the prophets. Readable says "wash away" for "cleanse".

source.text: וְהָ֣יְתָה לִּ֗י לְשֵׁ֤ם שָׂשׂוֹן֙ לִתְהִלָּ֣ה וּלְתִפְאֶ֔רֶת לְכֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁמְע֜וּ אֶת־כָּל־הַטּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽנֹכִי֙ עֹשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם וּפָחֲד֣וּ וְרָֽגְז֗וּ עַ֤ל כָּל־הַטּוֹבָה֙ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־הַשָּׁל֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָֽנֹכִ֖י עֹ֥שֶׂה לָּֽהּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it will be to me for a name of joy, for praise and for glory to all [the] nations of the earth who will hear all the good that I [am] doing [for] them; and they will fear and tremble because of all the good and because of all the peace that I [am] doing for it.

en.L: And it will be to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a name of joy, a praise and a glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good that I am doing for them; and they will fear and tremble because of all the good and because of all the peace that I am making for it.
en.B: This city will be for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a name of joy, praise and glory before all the nations of the earth. They will hear of all the good I do for its people, and they will be in awe and tremble because of all the good and all the peace I bring about for it.
en.R: Then this city will give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a name that brings joy, praise and honor among all the nations of the earth. They will hear about all the good things I do for its people. They will be amazed and shake with awe because of all the good things and the peace I give the city.

es.L: Y será para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} nombre de gozo, de alabanza y de gloria ante todas las naciones de la tierra, que oirán de todo el bien que yo les hago; y temerán y temblarán por todo el bien y por toda la paz que yo le doy.
es.B: Esta ciudad será para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} un nombre de gozo, de alabanza y de gloria ante todas las naciones de la tierra. Oirán de todo el bien que hago a su gente, y temblarán asombradas por todo el bien y toda la paz que le doy.
es.R: Entonces esta ciudad me dará un nombre que traerá gozo, alabanza y honra entre todas las naciones de la tierra. Oirán de todas las cosas buenas que hago por su gente. Se asombrarán y temblarán de respeto por todas las cosas buenas y la paz que le doy a la ciudad.

fr.L: Et elle sera pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un nom de joie, une louange et une gloire devant toutes les nations de la terre, qui apprendront tout le bien que je leur fais ; et elles craindront et trembleront à cause de tout le bien et de toute la paix que je lui procure.
fr.B: Cette ville sera pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un nom de joie, de louange et de gloire devant toutes les nations de la terre. Elles apprendront tout le bien que je fais à ses habitants, et elles seront saisies de crainte et trembleront à cause de tout le bien et de toute la paix que je lui accorde.
fr.R: Alors cette ville {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} donnera un nom qui apporte la joie, la louange et l’honneur parmi toutes les nations de la terre. Elles entendront parler de tout le bien que je fais à ses habitants. Elles seront émerveillées et trembleront de respect à cause de tout le bien et de la paix que je donne à la ville.

sw.L: Nao utakuwa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} jina la furaha, sifa na utukufu mbele ya mataifa yote ya dunia, watakaosikia mema yote ninayowatendea; nao wataogopa na kutetemeka kwa sababu ya mema yote na kwa sababu ya amani yote ninayouletea.
sw.B: Mji huu utakuwa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} jina la furaha, sifa na utukufu mbele ya mataifa yote ya dunia. Watasikia mema yote ninayowatendea watu wake, nao watastaajabu na kutetemeka kwa sababu ya mema yote na amani yote ninayouletea.
sw.R: Ndipo mji huu utanipa jina linaloleta furaha, sifa na heshima kati ya mataifa yote ya dunia. Watasikia mambo yote mema ninayowatendea watu wake. Watashangaa na kutetemeka kwa hofu kwa sababu ya mambo yote mema na amani ninayoupa mji huo.

vi.L: Thành ấy sẽ làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có một danh vui mừng, một sự ca ngợi và một sự vinh quang trước mọi dân tộc trên đất, là những dân sẽ nghe về mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho họ; chúng sẽ kính sợ và run rẩy vì mọi điều tốt lành và mọi sự bình an {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban cho thành ấy.
vi.B: Thành này sẽ đem lại cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một danh vui mừng, sự ca ngợi và vinh quang trước mọi dân tộc trên đất. Họ sẽ nghe về mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho dân thành, và họ sẽ kính sợ và run rẩy vì mọi điều tốt lành và mọi sự bình an {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban cho thành.
vi.R: Bấy giờ thành này sẽ đem lại cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một danh làm cho người ta vui mừng, ca ngợi và tôn vinh giữa mọi dân tộc trên đất. Họ sẽ nghe về mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho dân thành. Họ sẽ kinh ngạc và run rẩy vì mọi điều tốt lành và sự bình an {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban cho thành ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 이 성은 내가 그들에게 베푸는 모든 복을 듣게 될 땅의 모든 민족 앞에서 나에게 기쁨의 이름과 찬양과 영광이 될 것이다. 그들은 내가 이 성에 베푸는 모든 복과 모든 평안 때문에 두려워하며 떨 것이다.
ko.B: 이 성은 세상 모든 민족 앞에서 나에게 기쁨과 찬양과 영광의 이름이 될 것이다. 그 민족들은 내가 이 성의 백성에게 베푸는 모든 복에 대하여 듣고, 내가 이 성에 베푸는 모든 복과 평안 때문에 두려워하며 떨 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 이 성은 세상 모든 나라 가운데서 나에게 기쁨과 찬양과 영광을 돌리는 이름이 될 것이다. 그 나라들은 내가 이 성의 백성에게 해 주는 모든 좋은 일을 들을 것이다. 그들은 내가 이 성에 주는 모든 좋은 것과 평안을 보고 놀라며 떨 것이다.

decisions.choice: a name, a praise and a glory: what Israel was meant to be
decisions.reason: In 13:11 God said he had bound his people to himself like a belt, to be for him "a people, a name, a praise and a glory", but they would not listen. Deuteronomy 26:19 uses the same words. What the people failed to be, the restored city will become.

decisions.choice: it: the city; them: its people
decisions.reason: The verb "it will be" is feminine, pointing back to "this city" (verses 4-5). "Them" in "doing for them" are its people, and "it" at the end is the city again.

decisions.choice: fear and tremble: be shaken with awe
decisions.reason: The nations will not fear harm; they will be overwhelmed by the greatness of what God does. The first verb is used of a heart that thrills with wonder in Isaiah 60:5, and of turning in awe to the LORD in Hosea 3:5.

decisions.choice: this city, its people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the city and its people (m2). Readable says "a name that brings joy" for "a name of joy" and "amazed and shake" for "fear and tremble" (m3).

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עוֹד֮ יִשָּׁמַ֣ע בַּמָּקוֹם־הַזֶּה֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים חָרֵ֣ב ה֔וּא מֵאֵ֥ין אָדָ֖ם וּמֵאֵ֣ין בְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְחֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הַֽנְשַׁמּ֗וֹת מֵאֵ֥ין אָדָ֛ם וּמֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב וּמֵאֵ֥ין בְּהֵמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: again will be heard in the place the this, which you [are] saying, desolate [is] it, without human and without animal, in [the] cities of Judah and in [the] streets of Jerusalem that [are] desolated, without human and without inhabitant and without animal,

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: There will again be heard in this place, of which you are saying, 'It [is] a waste, without human or animal,' in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, without human and without inhabitant and without animal,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Once more there will be heard in this place, which you call a ruin with neither people nor animals, in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that lie deserted, without people, without anyone living there, without animals,
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: You say that this place is a ruin, with no people or animals in it. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are empty. No people live there, and there are not even any animals. But you will hear sounds there again.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Se oirá otra vez en este lugar, del cual {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: “Desierto [está], sin hombre y sin animal”, en las ciudades de Judá y en las calles de Jerusalén que están asoladas, sin hombre, y sin habitante, y sin animal,
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Otra vez se oirá en este lugar, que {{plural_you:ustedes llaman|vosotros llamáis}} una ruina sin gente ni animales, en las ciudades de Judá y en las calles de Jerusalén que están desiertas, sin gente, sin nadie que viva allí, sin animales,
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Ustedes dicen|Vosotros decís}} que este lugar es una ruina, sin gente ni animales. Las ciudades de Judá y las calles de Jerusalén están vacías. No vive gente allí, y ni siquiera hay animales. Pero allí se volverán a oír sonidos:

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : On entendra encore dans ce lieu dont vous dites : “C’[est] un désert, sans humains ni bêtes”, dans les villes de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem qui sont dévastées, sans humains, sans habitants et sans bêtes,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : On entendra de nouveau, dans ce lieu que vous dites en ruines, sans gens ni bêtes, dans les villes de Juda et les rues de Jérusalem qui sont désertes, sans gens, sans habitants, sans bêtes,
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Vous dites que ce lieu est en ruines, sans gens ni animaux. Les villes de Juda et les rues de Jérusalem sont vides. Personne n’y habite, et il n’y a même plus d’animaux. Mais vous y entendrez de nouveau des bruits.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Itasikika tena mahali hapa, ambapo ninyi mnasema, '[Ni] ukiwa, bila mwanadamu wala mnyama,' katika miji ya Yuda na katika njia za Yerusalemu zilizo ukiwa, bila mwanadamu, wala mkaaji, wala mnyama,
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Itasikika tena mahali hapa, mnapopaita magofu yasiyo na watu wala wanyama, katika miji ya Yuda na njia za Yerusalemu zilizoachwa tupu, bila watu, bila mtu anayeishi humo, bila wanyama,
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Mnasema kwamba mahali hapa ni magofu, bila watu wala wanyama. Miji ya Yuda na njia za Yerusalemu ni tupu. Hakuna watu wanaoishi humo, wala hata wanyama. Lakini mtasikia tena sauti huko.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Tại nơi này, là nơi các ngươi nói: 'Ấy [là] nơi hoang tàn, không có người cũng không có thú vật,' tại các thành của Giu-đa và các đường phố Giê-ru-sa-lem đã hoang vắng, không người, không cư dân, không thú vật, sẽ lại được nghe
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Tại nơi này, là nơi các ngươi gọi là hoang tàn, không người cũng không thú vật, tại các thành của Giu-đa và các đường phố Giê-ru-sa-lem đang hoang vắng, không người, không ai ở, không thú vật, sẽ lại vang lên
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Các ngươi nói rằng nơi này là chốn hoang tàn, không có người hay thú vật. Các thành của Giu-đa và các đường phố Giê-ru-sa-lem đều vắng tanh. Không ai sống ở đó, và cũng chẳng có thú vật nào. Nhưng các ngươi sẽ lại nghe những âm thanh ở đó.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희가 '사람도 짐승도 없는 황무지다.' 하고 말하는 이곳, 곧 사람도 주민도 짐승도 없이 황폐해진 유다의 성읍들과 예루살렘의 거리들에서 다시 들릴 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 사람도 짐승도 없는 폐허라고 말하는 이곳, 곧 사람도 주민도 짐승도 없이 황폐해진 유다의 성읍들과 예루살렘의 거리들에서 다시 들릴 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희는 이곳이 사람도 짐승도 없는 폐허라고 말한다. 유다의 성읍들과 예루살렘의 거리들은 텅 비어 있다. 거기에는 사는 사람이 없고, 짐승조차 없다. 그러나 너희는 거기에서 다시 소리를 듣게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: a waste, without people or animals: the people's own words about the land
decisions.reason: In 32:43 the people say of the land, "It is a desolation, without people or animals." God takes up their words of despair and answers them with a promise.

decisions.choice: will be heard: the sentence runs on into verse 11
decisions.reason: What will be heard again is listed in verse 11: the sounds of joy, of weddings and of thanksgiving. Literal and Balanced end this verse with a comma.

decisions.choice: the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem: the places named in the threat of 7:34
decisions.reason: God had said he would silence joy "in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem" (7:34; compare 44:6). The same places are named here for the promise that turns the threat around.

decisions.choice: But you will hear sounds there again.
decisions.reason: Readable puts the people's words first in short sentences, then says what will happen, so that verse 11 can begin a new sentence.

decisions.choice: the sentence left open at the end of verse 10
decisions.reason: As in the English, Literal and Balanced carry the sentence on into verse 11, where what will be heard is named.

decisions.choice: "다시 들릴 것이다" closing verse 10, with what is heard listed in verse 11
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb last, so verse 10 ends with "will be heard" and verse 11 names the sounds, each verse keeping its own content (meaning decision m2).

source.text: ק֣וֹל שָׂשׂ֞וֹן וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֗ה ק֣וֹל חָתָן֮ וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּה֒ ק֣וֹל אֹמְרִ֡ים הוֹדוּ֩ אֶת־יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת כִּֽי־ט֤וֹב יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔וֹ מְבִאִ֥ים תּוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־אָשִׁ֧יב אֶת־שְׁבוּת־הָאָ֛רֶץ כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [the] sound of joy and [the] sound of gladness, [the] voice of bridegroom and [the] voice of bride, [the] voice of [those] saying, Give thanks to Yahweh of hosts, for good [is] Yahweh, for to forever [is] his loyal love, bringing thank offering [to the] house of Yahweh; for I will turn back [the] fortunes of the land as at the first, says Yahweh.

en.L: the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those saying, 'Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever,' bringing thank offering [to] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. For I will restore the fortunes of the land as at the first, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bridegroom and bride, and the voices of those who say, 'Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies thanks, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever,' as they bring offerings of thanks to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were at the beginning, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You will hear the sounds of joy and happiness and the happy voices of a bride and groom at their wedding. You will hear people singing, 'Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is good! His faithful love lasts forever.' They will sing as they bring offerings to thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple. I will make things good again for the land, as they were before, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: la voz de gozo y la voz de alegría, la voz del novio y la voz de la novia, la voz de los que dicen: “{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] bueno, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre”, mientras traen ofrendas de acción de gracias [a] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Porque restauraré la suerte de la tierra como al principio, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: los sonidos de gozo y de alegría, las voces del novio y de la novia, y las voces de los que dicen: “{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre”, mientras traen ofrendas de gratitud a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Porque restauraré la suerte de la tierra como era al principio, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Se oirán los sonidos de gozo y felicidad y las voces alegres de los novios en su boda. Se oirá a la gente cantar: “{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre”. Cantarán mientras traen ofrendas para dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo. Haré que todo vuelva a ir bien en la tierra, como era antes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: le cri de joie et le cri d’allégresse, la voix du fiancé et la voix de la fiancée, la voix de ceux qui disent : “Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} des armées, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours”, et qui apportent des sacrifices de reconnaissance [à] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Car je rétablirai le sort du pays comme au commencement, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: les cris de joie et d’allégresse, les voix du fiancé et de la fiancée, et les voix de ceux qui disent : “Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} des armées, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon ; {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours”, tandis qu’ils apportent des offrandes de reconnaissance à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Car je rétablirai le sort du pays tel qu’il était au début, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous entendrez des cris de joie et de bonheur, et les voix joyeuses des mariés à leur mariage. Vous entendrez des gens chanter : “Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon ! Son amour fidèle dure toujours.” Ils chanteront en apportant des offrandes pour remercier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple. Je rendrai de nouveau le pays heureux, comme autrefois, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: sauti ya furaha na sauti ya shangwe, sauti ya bwana arusi na sauti ya bibi arusi, sauti ya wale wasemao, 'Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwema, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele,' wanapoleta sadaka ya shukrani [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa maana nitairudishia nchi mafanikio yake kama hapo kwanza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: sauti za furaha na shangwe, sauti za bwana arusi na bibi arusi, na sauti za wale wasemao, 'Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele,' wanapoleta sadaka za shukrani katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa maana nitairudishia nchi mafanikio yake kama ilivyokuwa mwanzoni, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mtasikia sauti za furaha na shangwe, na sauti za furaha za bibi arusi na bwana arusi harusini. Mtasikia watu wakiimba, 'Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema! Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.' Wataimba hivyo wanapoleta sadaka za kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Nitayafanya mambo ya nchi kuwa mema tena, kama yalivyokuwa zamani, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: tiếng vui mừng và tiếng hân hoan, tiếng chàng rể và tiếng cô dâu, tiếng những người nói: 'Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] tốt lành, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời,' khi họ đem lễ vật cảm tạ đến nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của xứ như lúc ban đầu, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: tiếng vui mừng hân hoan, tiếng chàng rể và cô dâu, và tiếng những người nói: 'Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là tốt lành; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời,' khi họ đem lễ vật cảm tạ đến nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của xứ như thuở ban đầu, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ lại nghe những tiếng vui mừng hớn hở và tiếng cười nói của cô dâu chú rể trong ngày cưới. Các ngươi sẽ nghe người ta hát: 'Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành! Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.' Họ sẽ hát như vậy khi đem lễ vật đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để cảm tạ Ngài. Ta sẽ làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại cho xứ này như trước kia, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 기뻐하는 소리와 즐거워하는 소리, 신랑의 목소리와 신부의 목소리, 그리고 '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 선하시고, 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.' 하고 말하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 감사 제물을 가져오는 자들의 소리가 [들릴 것이다]. 내가 이 땅의 운명을 돌이켜 처음과 같게 할 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 기뻐하고 즐거워하는 소리, 신랑과 신부의 목소리, 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 감사 제물을 가져오며 '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 선하시다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.' 하고 노래하는 사람들의 소리가 들릴 것이다. 내가 이 땅의 형편을 회복시켜 처음과 같게 할 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 너희는 기쁘고 즐거운 소리를 들을 것이다. 혼인 잔치에서 신랑과 신부의 즐거운 목소리를 들을 것이다. 사람들이 '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 좋으신 분이시다! 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.' 하고 노래하는 소리를 들을 것이다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 감사 제물을 가져오면서 노래할 것이다. 내가 이 땅을 전처럼 다시 잘되게 해 주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: the sound of joy and gladness, of bridegroom and bride: the threat of 7:34 turned around
decisions.reason: God had said he would silence these very sounds (7:34; 16:9; 25:10). Weddings were the most joyful times of town life, and their silence meant that ordinary life had ended. Now God promises that they will be heard again.

decisions.choice: Give thanks to the LORD ... his loyal love is forever: the refrain of Israel's worship
decisions.reason: These are the words that open Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136 and that were sung when the ark came to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 16:34) and when the second temple's foundation was laid (Ezra 3:11). Here the call names "the LORD of hosts" and then says "the LORD is good". The temple's songs will be sung again.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word is the love that keeps faith within a bond, God's commitment to his people that does not give up.

decisions.choice: thank offering: an offering given to thank God
decisions.reason: The word means both thanks and the offering that expresses it (17:26; Leviticus 7:12-15). Those who sing the refrain bring their thanks with them to the temple.

decisions.choice: restore the fortunes of the land: as in verse 7
decisions.reason: As in verse 7. Here the whole land is restored as it was at the beginning.

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:34 at each level
decisions.reason: The sounds of joy and of bride and bridegroom are worded as in 7:34 and 16:9, so that the promise is heard as the reversal of the threat. Readable adds "singing" for the voices that say the refrain.

decisions.choice: the refrain worded as Psalm 136:1 and 1 Chronicles 16:34
decisions.reason: The call to thanks keeps the wording of the psalms at each level: "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable, with "the LORD of hosts" (Literal) and "the LORD of Armies" (Balanced, Readable) in place of the plain divine name, and "the LORD" in place of "he" before "is good". The thank offering is worded as in 17:26.

decisions.choice: la voz de gozo y la voz de alegría, la voz del novio y la voz de la novia
decisions.reason: The sounds silenced in 25:10 (and 7:34) return; each level reuses its own Spanish wording of 25:10, turned from threat to promise.

decisions.choice: porque el SEÑOR [es] bueno, porque su amor leal [es] para siempre (Literal); porque el SEÑOR es bueno; su amor fiel dura para siempre (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The temple refrain keeps the published wording of Psalm 136:1, as the terms note sets for Ezra 3:11.

decisions.choice: the refrain of Psalm 136:1
decisions.reason: The temple refrain keeps the published Swahili of Psalm 136:1 and 1 Chronicles 16:34 at each level ("upendo wake usiokoma"), and the sounds of joy keep the wording of 25:10.

decisions.choice: the refrain worded as Psalm 136:1 in French: "Rendez grâce au SEIGNEUR ... car ... est bon, car son amour loyal [est] pour toujours" (L); "son amour fidèle dure toujours" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note says for this refrain (Ezra 3:11 too), each level keeps the published French of Psalm 136, so the reader recognizes the song; the sounds of joy keep the wording of 25:10.

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:34 and of the Psalm 136:1 refrain at each level
decisions.reason: The sounds of joy reverse 7:34 and take its Vietnamese words; the refrain takes the published wording of Psalm 136:1 and 1 Chronicles 16:34, with "CHÚA" named where those have "Ngài", as the Hebrew does here.

decisions.choice: The wording of 7:34 and 16:9 for the sounds of joy and of bridegroom and bride
decisions.reason: The threat of 7:34 is turned around (meaning decision m1), so Korean reuses the wording drafted there at each level.

decisions.choice: The refrain as Psalm 136:1: "감사하여라 ... 선하시다 ... 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다" (L, B); "좋으신 분이시다! 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다" (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of Israel's worship (meaning decision m2) keeps the published Korean of Psalm 136:1 at each level, as the terms note asks for Ezra 3:11.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ ע֞וֹד יִֽהְיֶ֣ה׀בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה הֶחָרֵ֛ב מֵֽאֵין־אָדָ֥ם וְעַד־בְּהֵמָ֖ה וּבְכָל־עָרָ֑יו נְוֵ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים מַרְבִּצִ֖ים צֹֽאן׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: again there will be in the place the this, the desolate, without human and up to animal, and in all its cities, a pasture of shepherds making flock[s] lie down.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: There will again be in this place, which is a waste, without human or animal, and in all its cities, a pasture for shepherds who make [their] flocks lie down.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: In this place that lies in ruins, without people or animals, and in all its towns, there will once again be pastures where shepherds rest their flocks.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: This place is now a ruin, with no people or animals. But in it and in all its towns there will again be fields where shepherds let their sheep lie down and rest.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Habrá otra vez en este lugar desierto, sin hombre ni animal, y en todas sus ciudades, majada de pastores que hagan recostar [sus] rebaños.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: En este lugar que está en ruinas, sin gente ni animales, y en todas sus ciudades, habrá otra vez pastizales donde los pastores hagan descansar a sus rebaños.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Ahora este lugar es una ruina, sin gente ni animales. Pero en él y en todas sus ciudades habrá otra vez campos donde los pastores dejen que sus ovejas se echen a descansar.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Il y aura encore dans ce lieu qui est un désert, sans humains ni bêtes, et dans toutes ses villes, un pâturage pour les bergers qui font reposer [leurs] troupeaux.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Dans ce lieu en ruines, sans gens ni bêtes, et dans toutes ses villes, il y aura de nouveau des pâturages où les bergers feront reposer leurs troupeaux.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Ce lieu est maintenant en ruines, sans gens ni animaux. Mais là et dans toutes ses villes, il y aura de nouveau des prés où les bergers laisseront leurs moutons se coucher et se reposer.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Patakuwa tena mahali hapa, palipo ukiwa, pasipo mwanadamu wala mnyama, na katika miji yake yote, malisho ya wachungaji wanaoyapumzisha makundi [yao].
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Mahali hapa palipo magofu, bila watu wala wanyama, na katika miji yake yote, patakuwa tena malisho ambapo wachungaji wanapumzisha makundi yao.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Mahali hapa sasa ni magofu, bila watu wala wanyama. Lakini humo na katika miji yake yote kutakuwa tena na malisho ambapo wachungaji watawalaza kondoo wao wapumzike.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Tại nơi hoang tàn này, không có người cũng không có thú vật, và trong mọi thành của nó, sẽ lại có đồng cỏ cho những người chăn cho bầy chiên nằm nghỉ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Tại nơi hoang tàn này, không người cũng không thú vật, và trong mọi thành của nó, sẽ lại có những đồng cỏ nơi người chăn cho bầy chiên nằm nghỉ.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Nơi này nay hoang tàn, không có người hay thú vật. Nhưng tại đây và trong mọi thành của nó sẽ lại có những đồng cỏ, nơi những người chăn cho chiên mình nằm nghỉ.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 사람도 짐승도 없는 황무지인 이곳과 그 모든 성읍에, 양 떼를 눕게 하는 목자들의 목장이 다시 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 사람도 짐승도 없이 폐허가 된 이곳과 그 모든 성읍에, 목자들이 양 떼를 쉬게 하는 목장이 다시 생길 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 이곳은 지금 사람도 짐승도 없는 폐허다. 그러나 이곳과 그 모든 성읍에 목자들이 양들을 눕혀 쉬게 하는 풀밭이 다시 생길 것이다.

decisions.choice: a pasture where shepherds rest their flocks: a picture of peace in the open country
decisions.reason: Flocks could lie down in the open fields only where no raiders or armies threatened. The land that is now empty of people and animals will be safe grazing land again.

decisions.choice: pasture: grazing land, or the place where shepherds stay
decisions.reason: The word can mean the pasture itself or the camp where shepherds and their flocks settle (23:3; Isaiah 65:10). Both fit here.

decisions.choice: without people or even animals
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "without human and up to animal", that is, without anyone at all, down to the animals. Verse 10 said the same with a different phrase.

decisions.choice: sheep
decisions.reason: Readable says "sheep" for flocks, which included both sheep and goats; Literal and Balanced say "flocks". Readable puts the present ruin first, then the promise.

source.text: בְּעָרֵ֨י הָהָ֜ר בְּעָרֵ֤י הַשְּׁפֵלָה֙ וּבְעָרֵ֣י הַנֶּ֔גֶב וּבְאֶ֧רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וּבִסְבִיבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּבְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה עֹ֣ד תַּעֲבֹ֧רְנָה הַצֹּ֛אן עַל־יְדֵ֥י מוֹנֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: In [the] cities of the hill country, in [the] cities of the Shephelah and in [the] cities of the Negev and in [the] land of Benjamin and in [the] surroundings of Jerusalem and in [the] cities of Judah, again will pass the flock[s] under [the] hands of [one] counting, says Yahweh.

en.L: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the Shephelah, and in the cities of the Negev, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts [them], says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: In the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, in Benjamin's territory, in the places surrounding Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hand of the one who counts them, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: In the towns of the hill country, of the foothills in the west and of the Negev desert in the south, in the land of Benjamin, in the villages near Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, shepherds will once again count their sheep as they pass by, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: En las ciudades de la región montañosa, en las ciudades de la Sefela, y en las ciudades del Néguev, y en la tierra de Benjamín, y en los alrededores de Jerusalén, y en las ciudades de Judá, pasarán otra vez los rebaños bajo las manos del que [los] cuenta, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: En las ciudades de la región montañosa, de las colinas del oeste y del Néguev, en el territorio de Benjamín, en los alrededores de Jerusalén y en las ciudades de Judá, los rebaños pasarán otra vez bajo la mano del que los cuenta, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: En las ciudades de la región montañosa, de las colinas del oeste y del desierto del Néguev en el sur, en la tierra de Benjamín, en las aldeas cerca de Jerusalén y en las ciudades de Judá, los pastores volverán a contar sus ovejas cuando pasen, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Dans les villes de la montagne, dans les villes de la Shéfela, et dans les villes du Néguev, et dans le pays de Benjamin, et dans les environs de Jérusalem, et dans les villes de Juda, les troupeaux passeront encore sous les mains de celui qui [les] compte, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Dans les villes de la montagne, des collines de l’ouest et du Néguev, dans le territoire de Benjamin, dans les environs de Jérusalem et dans les villes de Juda, les troupeaux passeront de nouveau sous la main de celui qui les compte, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Dans les villes de la région des montagnes, des collines à l’ouest et du désert du Néguev, au sud, dans le pays de Benjamin, dans les villages près de Jérusalem et dans les villes de Juda, les bergers compteront de nouveau leurs moutons quand ils passeront devant eux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Katika miji ya nchi ya milima, katika miji ya Shefela, na katika miji ya Negebu, na katika nchi ya Benyamini, na katika maeneo yanayouzunguka Yerusalemu, na katika miji ya Yuda, makundi yatapita tena chini ya mikono ya yeye ahesabuye, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Katika miji ya nchi ya milima, ya Shefela na ya Negebu, katika nchi ya Benyamini, katika maeneo yanayouzunguka Yerusalemu na katika miji ya Yuda, makundi yatapita tena chini ya mkono wa yule anayeyahesabu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Katika miji ya nchi ya milima, ya vilima vya magharibi na ya jangwa la Negebu upande wa kusini, katika nchi ya Benyamini, katika vijiji vilivyo karibu na Yerusalemu na katika miji ya Yuda, wachungaji watahesabu tena kondoo wao wanapopita, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Trong các thành miền núi, trong các thành vùng Sơ-phê-la, trong các thành vùng Nê-ghép, trong đất Bên-gia-min, trong các vùng quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem và trong các thành của Giu-đa, bầy chiên sẽ lại đi qua dưới tay người đếm [chúng], {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Trong các thành miền núi, các thành vùng đồi thấp phía tây và vùng Nê-ghép, trong địa phận Bên-gia-min, các vùng quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem và các thành của Giu-đa, bầy chiên sẽ lại đi qua dưới tay người đếm chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Trong các thành miền núi, vùng đồi thấp phía tây và sa mạc Nê-ghép phía nam, trong đất Bên-gia-min, các làng quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem và các thành của Giu-đa, những người chăn sẽ lại đếm chiên của mình khi chúng đi ngang qua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 산지의 성읍들과 스벨라의 성읍들과 네겝의 성읍들과 베냐민 땅과 예루살렘 주변과 유다의 성읍들에서, 양 떼가 다시 세는 자의 손 아래로 지나갈 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 산지의 성읍들과 서쪽 평지의 성읍들과 네겝의 성읍들에서, 베냐민 지방과 예루살렘 주변 지역과 유다의 성읍들에서, 양 떼가 다시 세는 사람의 손 아래로 지나갈 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 산지의 성읍들과 서쪽의 낮은 산지와 남쪽 네겝 사막의 성읍들에서, 베냐민 땅과 예루살렘 근처 마을들과 유다의 성읍들에서, 목자들이 다시 지나가는 양들을 셀 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: the hill country ... the towns of Judah: every region of the land
decisions.reason: The same list of regions is given in 17:26 and 32:44, where it is explained: the central hills, the Shephelah (the low hills to the west), the dry Negev to the south, Benjamin to the north, and the places around Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: pass under the hands of the one who counts: shepherds counting their animals
decisions.reason: At the end of the day a shepherd counted his flock as the animals passed one by one under his hand or his staff, to see that none were missing (Leviticus 27:32; Ezekiel 20:37). The picture is of ordinary, peaceful work in the land again.

decisions.choice: the Shephelah (L); the western foothills (B); the foothills in the west, the Negev desert in the south (R)
decisions.reason: As in 17:26: Literal keeps the region's name; Balanced and Readable say where it lies. Readable says plainly that the shepherds count their sheep.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán" (says the LORD) at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here is "amar YHWH", not "neʾum YHWH", so Literal and Balanced keep the plain "CHÚA phán", as the English keeps "says"; the regions are named as in 32:44.

decisions.choice: "스벨라" (L); "서쪽 평지" (B); "서쪽의 낮은 산지" (R); "네겝"
decisions.reason: The same wording as 32:44 for the regions of Judah.

source.text: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וַהֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתִּי אֶל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְעַל־בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, days [are] coming, declares Yahweh, and I will establish the word the good which I have spoken to [the] house of Israel and to [the] house of Judah.

en.L: Look, days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I will establish the good word that I have spoken to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
en.B: The days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I will carry out the good promise I made to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
en.R: The time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I will do the good things I promised to the people of Israel and Judah.

es.L: He aquí vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que cumpliré la buena palabra que he hablado a la casa de Israel y a la casa de Judá.
es.B: Vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que cumpliré la buena promesa que hice a la casa de Israel y a la casa de Judá.
es.R: Se acerca el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que haré las cosas buenas que prometí al pueblo de Israel y de Judá.

fr.L: Voici, des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où j’accomplirai la bonne parole que j’ai prononcée sur la maison d’Israël et sur la maison de Juda.
fr.B: Des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où j’accomplirai la bonne promesse que j’ai faite à la maison d’Israël et à la maison de Juda.
fr.R: Un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où je ferai le bien que j’ai promis au peuple d’Israël et à celui de Juda.

sw.L: Tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapolithibitisha neno jema nililoinena kwa nyumba ya Israeli na kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.B: Siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapotimiza ahadi njema niliyoifanya kwa nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.R: Wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapofanya mambo mema niliyoyaahidi watu wa Israeli na Yuda.

vi.L: Kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm ứng nghiệm lời tốt lành mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và nhà Giu-đa.
vi.B: Sẽ đến những ngày, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thực hiện lời hứa tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và nhà Giu-đa.
vi.R: Sẽ đến lúc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm những điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa.

ko.L: 보아라, 날들이 온다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘 집과 유다 집에 말한 그 좋은 말을 이루겠다.
ko.B: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘 집과 유다 집에 한 은혜로운 약속을 이루겠다.
ko.R: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘 백성과 유다 백성에게 약속한 좋은 일들을 이루겠다.

decisions.choice: verses 14-26 are part of the Hebrew text, though the Septuagint lacks them
decisions.reason: The Septuagint, the ancient Greek translation, has no equivalent of verses 14-26, the longest passage of the Hebrew book missing from the Greek (see the note at 1:1). The verses take up the promise of 23:5-6 and add the promises to David's line and to the Levitical priests. This translation follows the Hebrew text throughout.

decisions.choice: the good word: the promise of good
decisions.reason: "The good word" God has spoken is his promise to restore his people (29:10, where the same phrase is used of bringing them back after seventy years; compare 1 Kings 8:56).

decisions.choice: establish the word: make it stand, carry it out
decisions.reason: The verb means to raise up or make something stand. With "word" it means to fulfill a promise, to make it come true (11:5; 29:10).

decisions.choice: the wording of 23:5 at each level
decisions.reason: "Look, days are coming" is worded as in 23:5, the promise these verses take up. Balanced says "promise" for "word", and Readable "the good things I promised".

decisions.choice: Tazama, siku zinakuja (Literal); Siku zinakuja (Balanced); Wakati unakuja (Readable)
decisions.reason: 33:14-16 takes up the promise of 23:5-6, so each level keeps its Swahili wording there ("Chipukizi la haki", "BWANA Ni Haki Yetu") and changes only what the Hebrew changes.

source.text: בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אַצְמִ֥יחַ לְדָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צְדָקָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: In the days the those and at the time the that I will cause to sprout for David a branch of righteousness, and he will do justice and righteousness in the land.

en.L: In those days and at that time \q I will cause a Branch of righteousness to sprout for David, \q and he will do justice and righteousness in the land.
en.B: In those days and at that time \q I will make a righteous Branch spring up for David, \q and he will do justice and righteousness in the land.
