en.R: At that time I will make a righteous Branch grow from David's family. \q He will do what is just and righteous in the land.

es.L: En aquellos días y en aquel tiempo \q haré brotar a David un Retoño de justicia, \q y hará derecho y justicia en la tierra.
es.B: En aquellos días y en aquel tiempo \q haré brotar para David un Retoño justo, \q y practicará el derecho y la justicia en la tierra.
es.R: En ese tiempo haré que de la familia de David brote un Retoño justo. \q Él hará lo que es justo y correcto en la tierra.

fr.L: En ces jours-là et en ce temps-là, \q je ferai germer pour David un Germe de justice, \q et il pratiquera le droit et la justice dans le pays.
fr.B: En ces jours-là et en ce temps-là, \q je ferai pousser pour David un Germe juste, \q et il exercera le droit et la justice dans le pays.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je ferai pousser pour David un Germe juste, un roi de sa famille. \q Il fera ce qui est juste et droit dans le pays.

sw.L: Katika siku zile na wakati ule \q nitamchipushia Daudi Chipukizi la haki, \q naye atafanya hukumu na haki katika nchi.
sw.B: Katika siku hizo na wakati huo \q nitamchipushia Daudi Chipukizi la haki, \q naye atatenda haki na uadilifu katika nchi.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitamchipushia Daudi Chipukizi la haki kutoka ukoo wake. \q Atatenda yaliyo ya haki na adili katika nchi.

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy và vào lúc ấy, \q Ta sẽ làm cho một Chồi công chính nứt ra cho Đa-vít, \q Người sẽ thi hành công lý và sự công chính trong xứ.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy và vào lúc ấy, \q Ta sẽ làm cho một Chồi công chính mọc lên cho Đa-vít, \q và Người sẽ thi hành công lý và sự công chính trong xứ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho một Chồi công chính mọc lên từ dòng dõi Đa-vít. \q Người sẽ làm điều công bằng và ngay thẳng trong xứ.

ko.L: 그날들에, 그리고 그때에 \q 내가 다윗에게 의의 싹이 돋아나게 하겠다. \q 그는 그 땅에서 정의와 의를 행할 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에, 그리고 그때에 \q 내가 다윗에게서 의로운 싹이 돋아나게 하겠다. \q 그는 그 땅에서 정의와 의를 행할 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 다윗의 집안에서 의로운 싹이 자라나게 하겠다. \q 그는 그 땅에서 옳고 바른 일을 할 것이다.

decisions.choice: this verse repeats 23:5 with differences
decisions.reason: 23:5 begins "Look, days are coming" (here in verse 14) and has "I will raise up for David a righteous Branch" and "he will reign as king and act wisely". This verse has "in those days and at that time", "I will cause to sprout" and "a Branch of righteousness", and leaves out the line about his reign. Both end "he will do justice and righteousness in the land".

decisions.choice: a Branch for David: a coming king from David's line
decisions.reason: As in 23:5, where the title is explained: new growth from the family of David, though its kings have failed (Isaiah 11:1; Zechariah 3:8; 6:12).

decisions.choice: cause to sprout: the verb from the same root as Branch
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun share one root: God will make the shoot shoot up. The picture is of new growth from a stump that seemed dead.

decisions.choice: a Branch of righteousness: a righteous Branch
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the two nouns, "branch of righteousness", the usual way of saying "righteous branch". The king will be the rightful heir and will do what is right, as 23:5 says.

decisions.choice: set in lines as 23:5; its wording reused
decisions.reason: The verse repeats the poetic promise of 23:5, so it is set in lines like it, though the chapter around it is prose. Where the Hebrew is the same, the wording of 23:5 is kept at each level; Balanced and Readable say "righteous Branch" as there. Readable says "at that time" once for "in those days and at that time", and "grow from David's family" for "sprout for David".

decisions.choice: un Retoño de justicia (Literal); un Retoño justo (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 23:5 (meaning decision m1); each level reuses its Spanish wording there, with Literal "un Retoño de justicia" for the different Hebrew, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "un Germe de justice" (L), "un Germe juste" (B, R), with "germer" at Literal
decisions.reason: As 23:5, which this verse repeats: "Germe" with a capital, as the terms note sets; Literal keeps the play between the verb and the noun ("germer ... Germe"), as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "Chồi công chính"; "Người" for the king
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the Branch of 23:5 and 33:15, reused from 23:5 at each level; the verb "nứt ra / mọc lên" shares the picture of the shoot, as meaning decision m3 notes.

decisions.choice: "의의 싹" (L); "의로운 싹" (B, R); "돋아나게 하다"
decisions.reason: The terms note links 23:5 and 33:15 by "싹"; this verse reuses 23:5's wording and changes only what the Hebrew changes: Literal says "의의 싹" for "a Branch of righteousness", and the verb "돋아나게 하다" keeps the root shared with "싹" (meaning decision m3).

source.text: בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן לָבֶ֑טַח וְזֶ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא־לָ֖הּ יְהוָ֥ה׀צִדְקֵֽנוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: In the days the those will be saved Judah, and Jerusalem will dwell in security; and this [is that] which one will call to her: Yahweh [is] our righteousness.

en.L: In those days Judah will be saved, \q and Jerusalem will dwell in security; \q and this [is what] one will call her: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] our righteousness.'
en.B: In those days Judah will be saved, \q and Jerusalem will live in safety. \q And this is the name people will give her: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} Is Our Righteousness.'
en.R: At that time Judah will be saved, \q and Jerusalem will live in safety. \q People will call the city by this name: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} Is Our Righteousness.'

es.L: En aquellos días Judá será salvo, \q y Jerusalén habitará segura; \q y este [es el nombre] con que la llamarán: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] nuestra justicia”.
es.B: En aquellos días Judá será salvado, \q y Jerusalén vivirá segura. \q Y este es el nombre que le darán: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Es Nuestra Justicia”.
es.R: En ese tiempo Judá será salvado, \q y Jerusalén vivirá segura. \q La gente llamará a la ciudad con este nombre: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Es Nuestra Justicia”.

fr.L: En ces jours-là, Juda sera sauvé, \q et Jérusalem habitera en sécurité ; \q et voici comment on l’appellera : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] notre justice.”
fr.B: En ces jours-là, Juda sera sauvé, \q et Jérusalem vivra en sécurité. \q Et voici le nom qu’on lui donnera : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}-notre-justice.”
fr.R: En ce temps-là, Juda sera sauvé, \q et Jérusalem vivra en sécurité. \q On appellera la ville par ce nom : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}-notre-justice.”

sw.L: Katika siku zile Yuda ataokolewa, \q na Yerusalemu atakaa salama; \q na hili [ndilo] atakaloitwa: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] haki yetu.'
sw.B: Katika siku hizo Yuda ataokolewa, \q na Yerusalemu utaishi salama. \q Na hili ndilo jina watu watakalompa: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Ni Haki Yetu.'
sw.R: Wakati huo Yuda ataokolewa, \q na Yerusalemu utaishi salama. \q Watu watauita mji huo kwa jina hili: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Ni Haki Yetu.'

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy, Giu-đa sẽ được cứu, \q và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ ở yên ổn; \q và đây [là danh] người ta sẽ gọi thành ấy: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] sự công chính của chúng ta.'
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, Giu-đa sẽ được cứu, \q và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ sống an ninh. \q Đây là danh người ta sẽ đặt cho thành ấy: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Là Sự Công Chính Của Chúng Ta.'
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, Giu-đa sẽ được cứu, \q và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ sống an toàn. \q Người ta sẽ gọi thành ấy bằng danh này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Là Sự Công Chính Của Chúng Ta.'

ko.L: 그날들에 유다가 구원을 받고, \q 예루살렘이 안전하게 살 것이다. \q 사람들이 그를 부를 [이름은] 이것이다. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의.'
ko.B: 그날에 유다가 구원을 받고, \q 예루살렘이 평안히 살 것이다. \q 사람들은 그 성을 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의'라는 이름으로 부를 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 유다는 구원을 받고, \q 예루살렘은 안전하게 살 것이다. \q 사람들은 그 성을 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의'라고 부를 것이다.

decisions.choice: differences from 23:6: Jerusalem, not Israel, and the name given to the city
decisions.reason: 23:6 says "in his days", "Israel will dwell in security" and "this is his name", the name of the king. Here it is "in those days", Jerusalem dwells in security, and the name is given "to her", the city. The king and his city bear one name.

decisions.choice: The LORD is our righteousness: the city named for what God does
decisions.reason: As in 23:6, where the name is explained: the LORD himself is the one who puts his people in the right and makes things right. The city that God rebuilds takes its name from him, as the city of Ezekiel 48:35 is called "The LORD is there".

decisions.choice: that one will call her: people will call the city
decisions.reason: The verb has no subject named: "one will call", the Hebrew way of saying "she will be called". "Her" is Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: the wording of 23:6, in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: The verse is worded as 23:6 where the Hebrew is the same and set in lines like it. Because the name stands inside the LORD's speech, it takes single quotation marks here. Readable says "the city" for "her".

decisions.choice: the wording of 23:6, now given to the city
decisions.reason: The name is worded as in 23:6 at each level, so the reader sees the echo; here it is the city that bears it (meaning decision m1), so Vietnamese says "thành ấy".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의", in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: The wording of 23:6 (meaning decision m1), now given to the city; the marks are single because the whole speech stands inside God's words to Jeremiah, which opened at verse 2.

source.text: כִּי־כֹ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֣ת לְדָוִ֔ד אִ֕ישׁ יֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֥א בֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: not will be cut off for David a man sitting on [the] throne of [the] house of Israel.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: There will not be cut off for David a man sitting on the throne of the house of Israel.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: David will always have a man of his line to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: There will always be a man from David's family to sit on the throne and rule Israel.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No le faltará a David varón que se siente sobre el trono de la casa de Israel.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: David siempre tendrá un hombre de su linaje que se siente en el trono de la casa de Israel.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Siempre habrá un hombre de la familia de David que se siente en el trono y gobierne a Israel.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Il ne manquera pas à David un homme assis sur le trône de la maison d’Israël.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : David aura toujours un homme de sa lignée pour siéger sur le trône de la maison d’Israël.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Il y aura toujours un homme de la famille de David pour siéger sur le trône et régner sur Israël.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Daudi hatakosa mtu wa kuketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Daudi atakuwa na mtu wa ukoo wake daima wa kuketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Daima kutakuwa na mtu kutoka ukoo wa Daudi wa kuketi juu ya kiti cha enzi na kutawala Israeli.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Đa-vít sẽ không bao giờ thiếu một người ngồi trên ngai nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Đa-vít sẽ luôn có một người thuộc dòng dõi mình ngồi trên ngai nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Sẽ luôn có một người thuộc dòng dõi Đa-vít ngồi trên ngai để cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 이스라엘 집의 왕좌에 앉을 사람이 다윗에게서 끊어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 다윗의 자손 가운데서 이스라엘 집의 왕좌에 앉을 사람이 언제나 있을 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 다윗의 집안에서 왕좌에 앉아 이스라엘을 다스릴 사람이 언제나 있을 것이다.

decisions.choice: a man on the throne: the promise to David
decisions.reason: God promised David that his line and his throne would last forever (2 Samuel 7:12-16). The words "there will not be cut off for you a man on the throne of Israel" are those of 1 Kings 2:4; 8:25; 9:5, where the promise depends on the kings' faithfulness.

decisions.choice: not be cut off for David: David will never be without an heir
decisions.reason: "Cut off" is used of a family line that dies out. The promise is that David's line will always have someone to take the throne.

decisions.choice: a promise spoken as the kingdom falls
decisions.reason: The words come while Jerusalem is under siege and the last king of Judah is about to lose his throne (32:3-5). The promise looks past the fall to the Branch of verse 15.

decisions.choice: a man of his line (B); a man from David's family (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the man is one of David's descendants, as the idiom implies (m2). Readable turns the negative into "there will always be" and says "rule Israel" for "the throne of the house of Israel".

source.text: וְלַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֥ת אִ֖ישׁ מִלְּפָנָ֑י מַעֲלֶ֨ה עוֹלָ֜ה וּמַקְטִ֥יר מִנְחָ֛ה וְעֹ֥שֶׂה־זֶּ֖בַחכָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And for the priests the Levites not will be cut off a man from before me offering up burnt offering and burning grain offering and making sacrifice all the days.

en.L: And for the priests, the Levites, there will not be cut off a man before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} offering up burnt offering and burning grain offering and making sacrifice all the days."
en.B: Nor will the priests, the Levites, ever be without a man who serves in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence, offering burnt offerings, burning grain offerings and making sacrifices for all time."
en.R: And there will always be priests from the tribe of Levi to serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They will offer burnt offerings, burn grain offerings and make sacrifices to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for all time."

es.L: Y a los sacerdotes levitas no les faltará varón delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} que ofrezca holocausto, y queme ofrenda de cereal, y haga sacrificio todos los días».
es.B: Tampoco les faltará nunca a los sacerdotes levitas un hombre que sirva en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia, ofreciendo holocaustos, quemando ofrendas de cereal y haciendo sacrificios para siempre».
es.R: Y siempre habrá sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirvan. Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ofrecerán holocaustos, quemarán ofrendas de cereal y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} harán sacrificios para siempre».

fr.L: Et aux prêtres, les Lévites, il ne manquera pas devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un homme qui offre l’holocauste, qui fasse fumer l’offrande et qui fasse le sacrifice tous les jours. »
fr.B: Et les prêtres lévites ne manqueront jamais d’un homme qui se tienne devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pour offrir des holocaustes, faire fumer des offrandes et faire des sacrifices pour toujours. »
fr.R: Et il y aura toujours des prêtres de la tribu de Lévi pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servir. Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}offriront des sacrifices complets, des offrandes de céréales et d’autres sacrifices pour toujours. »

sw.L: Wala makuhani, Walawi, hawatakosa mtu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} atoaye sadaka za kuteketezwa, na kufukiza sadaka za unga, na kutoa dhabihu siku zote."
sw.B: Wala makuhani, Walawi, hawatakosa kamwe mtu atakayehudumu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, akitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa, akifukiza sadaka za unga na kutoa dhabihu daima."
sw.R: Na daima kutakuwa na makuhani kutoka kabila la Lawi wa kunitumikia. Watatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa, watafukiza sadaka za unga na kunitolea dhabihu daima."

vi.L: Còn các thầy tế lễ, là người Lê-vi, cũng sẽ không bao giờ thiếu một người trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để dâng tế lễ thiêu, đốt tế lễ chay và dâng sinh tế mọi ngày."
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ người Lê-vi cũng sẽ không bao giờ thiếu một người phục vụ trước mặt Ta, dâng tế lễ thiêu, đốt tế lễ chay và dâng sinh tế mãi mãi."
vi.R: Cũng sẽ luôn có những thầy tế lễ thuộc chi tộc Lê-vi để phục vụ Ta. Họ sẽ dâng tế lễ thiêu, đốt tế lễ chay và dâng sinh tế cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi."

ko.L: 그리고 레위 사람 제사장들에게도 내 앞에서 번제물을 바치고 곡식 제물을 태우고 날마다 희생 제물을 드릴 사람이 끊어지지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 레위 사람 제사장들에게도 내 앞에서 섬기며 번제물을 바치고 곡식 제물을 태우고 언제나 희생 제물을 드릴 사람이 없어지지 않을 것이다."
ko.R: 그리고 레위 지파의 제사장들이 언제나 나를 섬길 것이다. 그들은 번제물을 바치고 곡식 제물을 태우며 나에게 희생 제물을 드릴 것이다."

decisions.choice: the Levitical priests will not lack a man: the covenant of priesthood
decisions.reason: God gave Phinehas, Aaron's grandson, "a covenant of lasting priesthood" for him and his descendants (Numbers 25:13). Malachi 2:4-5 speaks of God's covenant with Levi. The promise to the priests stands beside the promise to David, as verses 21-22 say again.

decisions.choice: the priests, the Levites: priests who belong to the tribe of Levi
decisions.reason: This is Deuteronomy's way of naming the priests (Deuteronomy 17:9; 18:1). Verse 21 puts the two words the other way round, "the Levites, the priests"; the same people are meant.

decisions.choice: burnt offerings, grain offerings and sacrifices: the daily worship of the temple
decisions.reason: As in 17:26, where the offerings are explained. "All the days" means always, without a break.

decisions.choice: priests from the tribe of Levi
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the Levitical priests" means (m2) and turns the negative into "there will always be".

decisions.choice: "레위 사람 제사장들" (L, B); "레위 지파의 제사장들" (R)
decisions.reason: The priests who belong to the tribe of Levi (meaning decision m2), as the published Korean of Deuteronomy and Chronicles names them.

ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예레미야에게 임했다.
ko.R: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 이 말씀을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: a new word to Jeremiah
decisions.reason: A further word begins here, introduced in the third person. Verses 19-26 continue the passage that the Septuagint lacks (see verse 14).

decisions.choice: the wording set for this formula in Jeremiah
decisions.reason: As in 24:4, with "to Jeremiah" for "to me".

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־תָּפֵ֨רוּ֙ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וְאֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י הַלָּ֑יְלָה וּלְבִלְתִּ֛י הֱי֥וֹת יֽוֹמָם־וָלַ֖יְלָה בְּעִתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: if you break my covenant [of] the day and my covenant [of] the night, and so that not [there] be daytime and night at their time,

en.L: "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: If you could break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with the day and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with the night, so that there would not be day and night at their time,
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: If you could break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with day and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with night, and stop day and night from coming at their set times,
en.R: "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I have made a covenant with day and with night, so that each comes at its proper time. Could you break that covenant, so that day and night stopped coming?

es.L: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Si {{plural_you:pudieran ustedes|pudierais vosotros}} romper {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con el día y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con la noche, de modo que no haya día ni noche a su tiempo,
es.B: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Si {{plural_you:pudieran ustedes|pudierais vosotros}} romper {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con el día y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con la noche, e impedir que el día y la noche lleguen a su tiempo,
es.R: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Yo hice un pacto con el día y con la noche, para que cada uno llegue a su debido tiempo. ¿Podrían {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} romper ese pacto, de modo que el día y la noche dejaran de llegar?

fr.L: « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Si vous pouviez rompre {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec le jour et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec la nuit, en sorte qu’il n’y ait plus de jour et de nuit en leur temps,
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Si vous pouviez rompre {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec le jour et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec la nuit, et empêcher le jour et la nuit de venir au moment fixé,
fr.R: « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : J’ai fait une alliance avec le jour et avec la nuit, pour que chacun vienne en son temps. Pourriez-vous rompre cette alliance, pour que le jour et la nuit ne viennent plus ?

sw.L: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kama mngeweza kuvunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} la mchana na agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} la usiku, hata usiwepo mchana wala usiku kwa wakati wake,
sw.B: "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kama mngeweza kuvunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na mchana na agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na usiku, na kuzuia mchana na usiku visije kwa nyakati zake,
sw.R: "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nimefanya agano na mchana na usiku, ili kila kimoja kije kwa wakati wake. Je, mngeweza kulivunja agano hilo, hata mchana na usiku visije tena?

vi.L: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Nếu các ngươi có thể hủy giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với ban ngày và giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với ban đêm, để ngày và đêm không đến đúng thời của chúng,
vi.B: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Nếu các ngươi có thể hủy giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với ngày và giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với đêm, khiến ngày và đêm không đến đúng thời đã định,
vi.R: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta đã lập giao ước với ngày và với đêm, để mỗi thứ đến đúng thời của nó. Các ngươi có thể hủy giao ước ấy, để ngày và đêm thôi không đến nữa không?

ko.L: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희가 낮에 대한 내 언약과 밤에 대한 내 언약을 깨뜨려서, 낮과 밤이 제때에 오지 않게 할 수 있다면,
ko.B: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 낮과 맺은 내 언약과 밤과 맺은 내 언약을 깨뜨려서, 낮과 밤이 정해진 때에 오지 않게 할 수 있다면,
ko.R: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 낮과 밤과 언약을 맺어서, 낮과 밤이 저마다 제때에 오게 했다. 너희가 그 언약을 깨뜨려서 낮과 밤이 오지 않게 할 수 있겠느냐?

decisions.choice: my covenant with the day and with the night: God's fixed order for creation
decisions.reason: God's ordering of day and night is called a covenant, a bond he has made and keeps. After the flood he promised that day and night would not cease (Genesis 8:22) and made a covenant with every living creature (Genesis 9:9-17).

decisions.choice: if you can break: a condition that cannot be met
decisions.reason: No one can stop day and night from coming. The condition is impossible, and so is what follows in verse 21: God's covenant with David will not be broken. 31:35-36 makes the same kind of argument.

decisions.choice: at their time: at the time set for them
decisions.reason: Each comes at its own appointed time, morning and evening, without fail.

decisions.choice: the condition as a statement and a question
decisions.reason: Readable first states the covenant, then asks the impossible question, so that the argument is easy to follow.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:pudieran ustedes|pudierais vosotros}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" here is plural, the hearers of the promise, so it takes the plural_you span.

decisions.choice: Verse 20 ending in "있다면," and running into verse 21
decisions.reason: The impossible condition (meaning decision m2) and its result are one sentence in the Hebrew; Korean can keep it so, because the condition ends verse 20 and the result begins verse 21. Readable makes them a statement and a question, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: also my covenant may be broken with David my servant, from there being to him a son reigning on his throne, and with the Levites the priests my ministers.

en.L: then also {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with David {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant could be broken, so that he would not have a son reigning on his throne, and [{{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant] with the Levites, the priests, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ministers.
en.B: then {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David could also be broken, and he would have no son to reign on his throne; and so could {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with the Levites, the priests who serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Only then could {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David be broken. Only then would he have no son to rule as king after him. And only then could {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with the priests from the tribe of Levi, who serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, be broken.

es.L: también podría romperse {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con David {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, para que no tenga hijo que reine sobre su trono, y [{{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto] con los levitas sacerdotes, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ministros.
es.B: entonces también podría romperse {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David, y él no tendría un hijo que reinara en su trono; y también {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con los levitas, los sacerdotes que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirven.
es.R: Solo entonces podría romperse {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David. Solo entonces se quedaría él sin un hijo que reinara después de él. Y solo entonces podría romperse {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví, que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirven.

fr.L: alors aussi {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec David, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, pourrait être rompue, en sorte qu’il n’ait plus de fils qui règne sur son trône, et [{{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance] avec les Lévites, les prêtres, {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ministres.
fr.B: alors {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David pourrait aussi être rompue, et il n’aurait plus de fils pour régner sur son trône ; et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec les Lévites, les prêtres qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent, pourrait l’être aussi.
fr.R: C’est seulement alors que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David pourrait être rompue. C’est seulement alors qu’il n’aurait plus de fils pour régner après lui. Et c’est seulement alors que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec les prêtres de la tribu de Lévi, qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent, pourrait être rompue.

sw.R: Ni hapo tu ambapo agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi lingeweza kuvunjwa. Ni hapo tu ambapo asingekuwa na mwana wa kutawala kama mfalme baada yake. Na ni hapo tu ambapo agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na makuhani wa kabila la Lawi, wanaonitumikia, lingeweza kuvunjwa.

vi.L: thì giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng có thể bị hủy, để người không còn con trai trị vì trên ngai mình, và [giao ước Ta] với người Lê-vi, là các thầy tế lễ, những người phục vụ Ta.
vi.B: thì giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mới có thể bị hủy, khiến người không còn con trai trị vì trên ngai mình; và giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với người Lê-vi, là các thầy tế lễ phục vụ Ta, cũng vậy.
vi.R: Chỉ khi đó giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mới có thể bị hủy. Chỉ khi đó người mới không còn con trai làm vua kế vị. Và chỉ khi đó giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với các thầy tế lễ thuộc chi tộc Lê-vi, là những người phục vụ Ta, mới có thể bị hủy.

ko.L: 내 종 다윗과 맺은 내 언약도 깨어져서 그의 왕좌에 앉아 다스릴 아들이 그에게 없게 되고, 나를 섬기는 레위 사람 제사장들과 맺은 [내 언약도 깨어질 것이다].
ko.B: 내 종 다윗과 맺은 내 언약도 깨어져서 그의 왕좌에 앉아 다스릴 아들이 그에게 없게 될 것이다. 나를 섬기는 레위 사람 제사장들과 맺은 내 언약도 그렇게 깨어질 것이다.
ko.R: 그럴 수 있어야만 내 종 다윗과 맺은 내 언약도 깨어질 수 있다. 그럴 수 있어야만 그의 뒤를 이어 왕이 될 아들이 그에게 없게 될 것이다. 그럴 수 있어야만 나를 섬기는 레위 지파의 제사장들과 맺은 내 언약도 깨어질 수 있다.

decisions.choice: my covenant with David my servant: the promise of 2 Samuel 7
decisions.reason: God's promise of a lasting throne to David (2 Samuel 7:12-16) is called a covenant in 2 Samuel 23:5 and Psalm 89:4. Psalm 89:37-38 compares David's throne to the sun and the moon, as this passage compares God's covenant to day and night.

decisions.choice: the Levites, the priests, my ministers: the covenant of priesthood
decisions.reason: As in verse 18 (Numbers 25:13; Malachi 2:4-5). "Ministers" are those who serve God in his house.

decisions.choice: then also my covenant could be broken: the result of the impossible condition
decisions.reason: The sentence completes verse 20: only if day and night could be stopped could these covenants fail.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a slave or servant. Said by God of David, it is a title of honor, so it is "servant" at every level, as in the rest of the prophets.

decisions.choice: "Đa-vít đầy tớ Ta"
decisions.reason: God's servants are "đầy tớ" at every level (terms note), as in 2 Samuel 7:5.

decisions.choice: "내 종 다윗"
decisions.reason: As the terms note: God's servant is "종" at every level, "내 종" in God's mouth.

records.literal_gloss: As not can be counted the host of the heavens and not can be measured the sand of the sea, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites ministering me.

en.L: As the host of the heavens cannot be counted and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant and the Levites who minister to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: As the stars of the sky cannot be counted and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will multiply the descendants of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David and the Levites who serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: No one can count the stars in the sky or measure the sand on the seashore. In the same way, I will make the descendants of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David and the Levites who serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} too many to count."

es.L: Como no se puede contar el ejército de los cielos ni medir la arena del mar, así multiplicaré la descendencia de David {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo y a los levitas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirven».
es.B: Así como no se pueden contar las estrellas del cielo ni medir la arena del mar, así multiplicaré a los descendientes de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David y a los levitas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirven».
es.R: Nadie puede contar las estrellas del cielo ni medir la arena de la playa. De la misma manera, haré que los descendientes de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David y los levitas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirven sean tantos que no se puedan contar».

fr.L: Comme l’armée des cieux ne peut être comptée, ni le sable de la mer mesuré, ainsi je multiplierai la descendance de David, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, et les Lévites qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent. »
fr.B: Comme on ne peut compter les étoiles du ciel ni mesurer le sable de la mer, ainsi je multiplierai les descendants de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David et les Lévites qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent. »
fr.R: Personne ne peut compter les étoiles du ciel ni mesurer le sable du bord de la mer. De la même manière, je rendrai les descendants de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David et les Lévites qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent si nombreux qu’on ne pourra pas les compter. »

sw.L: Kama jeshi la mbinguni lisivyoweza kuhesabika, wala mchanga wa bahari usivyoweza kupimika, ndivyo nitakavyouongeza uzao wa Daudi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na Walawi wanaonihudumia."
sw.B: Kama nyota za angani zisivyoweza kuhesabika na mchanga wa bahari usivyoweza kupimika, ndivyo nitakavyowaongeza wazao wa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi na Walawi wanaonitumikia."
sw.R: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kuhesabu nyota za angani wala kupima mchanga wa pwani. Vivyo hivyo, nitawafanya wazao wa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi na Walawi wanaonitumikia kuwa wengi mno kuhesabika."

vi.L: Như cơ binh trên trời không thể đếm được, và cát biển không thể đong được thể nào, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ làm cho dòng dõi Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và người Lê-vi phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gia tăng thể ấy."
vi.B: Như các ngôi sao trên trời không thể đếm được và cát biển không thể đong được, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ làm cho dòng dõi Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và người Lê-vi phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gia tăng như vậy."
vi.R: Không ai đếm được các ngôi sao trên trời hay đong được cát trên bờ biển. Cũng vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho dòng dõi Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và người Lê-vi phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đông đến nỗi không ai đếm được."

ko.L: 하늘의 군대를 셀 수 없고 바다의 모래를 잴 수 없듯이, 내가 내 종 다윗의 자손과 나를 섬기는 레위 사람들을 많아지게 하겠다."
ko.B: 하늘의 별을 셀 수 없고 바다의 모래를 잴 수 없듯이, 내가 내 종 다윗의 자손과 나를 섬기는 레위 사람들을 그렇게 많아지게 하겠다."
ko.R: 아무도 하늘의 별을 셀 수 없고 바닷가의 모래를 잴 수 없다. 그처럼 내가 내 종 다윗의 자손과 나를 섬기는 레위 사람들을 셀 수 없을 만큼 많아지게 하겠다."

decisions.choice: the stars and the sand: the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: God promised Abraham descendants as many as the stars and the sand on the seashore (Genesis 15:5; 22:17; 32:13). The same promise is now made to David's line and to the Levites.

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens: the stars
decisions.reason: Here the phrase means the countless stars. Elsewhere Jeremiah uses it of the stars that the people wrongly worshiped (8:2; 19:13).

decisions.choice: the Levites who minister to me
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "who minister me", with the object marker on "me", an unusual way of saying "who serve me".

decisions.choice: the stars of the sky (B); the stars in the sky (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the host of the heavens is (m2). Readable says "too many to count" for "multiply".

decisions.choice: "하늘의 군대" (L); "하늘의 별" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 19:13 and 2 Kings 23:5: Literal keeps "the host of the heavens", and Balanced and Readable say "stars" (meaning decision m2).

records.literal_gloss: [Have] not you seen what the people the this have spoken, saying, [the] two the clans which chose Yahweh in them, and he has rejected them? And my people they despise, from being again a nation before them.

en.L: "Have you not seen what this people have spoken, saying, 'The two clans that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} chose, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has rejected them'? And they despise {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, [as] no longer a nation before them.
en.B: "Have you not seen what these people are saying: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} chose two families, and now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has rejected them'? So they look down on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, as if they were no longer a nation in their eyes.
en.R: "Have you heard what these people are saying? They say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} chose two families, Israel and Judah, but now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has turned away from them.' So they treat {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people with scorn. They do not think of them as a nation anymore.

es.L: «¿No has visto lo que ha hablado este pueblo, diciendo: “Las dos familias que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escogió, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} las ha desechado”? Y desprecian a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, [como si] no fuera más nación delante de ellos.
es.B: «¿No has visto lo que dice esta gente: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escogió a dos familias, y ahora las ha desechado”? Así desprecian a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, como si ya no fuera una nación a sus ojos.
es.R: «¿Has oído lo que dice esta gente? Dicen: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escogió a dos familias, Israel y Judá, pero ahora les ha dado la espalda”. Así tratan con desprecio a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. Ya no lo consideran una nación.

fr.L: « N’as-tu pas vu ce que ce peuple a dit : “Les deux clans que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rejetés” ? Et ils méprisent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, [comme] n’étant plus une nation devant eux.
fr.B: « N’as-tu pas vu ce que disent ces gens : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisi deux familles, et maintenant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rejetées” ? Ainsi ils méprisent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, comme s’il n’était plus une nation à leurs yeux.
fr.R: « As-tu entendu ce que disent ces gens ? Ils disent : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisi deux familles, Israël et Juda, mais maintenant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est détourné d’elles.” Ainsi ils traitent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple avec mépris. Ils ne le considèrent plus comme une nation.

sw.L: "Je, hujaona yale ambayo watu hawa wameyanena, wakisema, 'Jamaa mbili ambazo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alizichagua, amezikataa'? Nao wanawadharau watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, [kana kwamba] si taifa tena mbele yao.
sw.B: "Je, hujaona wanachosema watu hawa: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alichagua jamaa mbili, na sasa amezikataa'? Hivyo wanawadharau watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kana kwamba si taifa tena machoni pao.
sw.R: "Je, umesikia wanachosema watu hawa? Wanasema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alichagua jamaa mbili, Israeli na Yuda, lakini sasa amewaacha.' Kwa hiyo wanawadharau watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Hawawahesabu tena kuwa taifa.

vi.L: "Ngươi không thấy dân này đã nói gì sao? Chúng nói: 'Hai gia tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã loại bỏ họ.' Chúng khinh dể dân Ta, [coi như] không còn là một dân tộc trước mắt chúng nữa.
vi.B: "Con không thấy những người này đang nói gì sao? Chúng nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn hai gia tộc, nay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã loại bỏ họ.' Vì thế chúng khinh dể dân Ta, như thể dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không còn là một dân tộc trước mắt chúng.
vi.R: "Con có nghe những người này đang nói gì không? Chúng nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn hai gia tộc là Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa, nhưng nay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã quay lưng với họ.' Vì thế chúng khinh dể dân Ta. Chúng không còn coi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là một dân tộc nữa.

ko.L: "이 백성이 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하신 두 족속을 그분께서 버리셨다.' 하고 말하는 것을 너는 보지 못했느냐? 그들은 내 백성을 멸시하여, 그들 앞에서 다시는 한 민족이 아닌 [것처럼 여긴다].
ko.B: "이 백성이 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 두 집안을 택하셨는데, 이제 그들을 버리셨다.' 하고 말하는 것을 너는 보지 못했느냐? 그래서 그들은 내 백성을 업신여기며, 더 이상 한 민족으로 여기지 않는다.
ko.R: "이 백성이 하는 말을 너는 들었느냐? 그들은 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘과 유다 두 집안을 택하셨지만, 이제는 그들에게서 등을 돌리셨다.' 하고 말한다. 그래서 그들은 내 백성을 업신여긴다. 그들은 내 백성을 더 이상 한 민족으로 생각하지 않는다.

decisions.choice: the two families: Israel and Judah
alternatives: the house of David and the Levites
decisions.reason: The word is the one for a clan, here used of whole peoples, as in Amos 3:1-2, where all Israel is "the whole family" God brought up from Egypt. The two are most likely the two kingdoms, Israel and Judah (3:6-11; 11:10). Some take them as David's line and the Levites, the two chosen houses of verses 17-22, or as Jacob's descendants and David's (verse 26).

decisions.choice: this people: who are speaking is not said
decisions.reason: "This people" in Jeremiah is often Judah itself (14:10-11), and the words may be the people's own despair. But the end of the verse says that "they" despise "my people", which suggests outsiders, perhaps the neighboring nations, mocking them. The Hebrew leaves it open.

decisions.choice: chosen and rejected: the language of covenant
decisions.reason: God chose Israel to be his own people (Deuteronomy 7:6; 14:2). The speakers say that he has now rejected them, as he had warned (7:29; 2 Kings 17:20). God's answer in verses 25-26 is that he will not.

decisions.choice: no longer a nation before them: in their eyes no nation at all
decisions.reason: "Before them" means in their view. They count God's people as finished.

decisions.choice: clans (L); families (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "clans", the usual word for this term. Balanced and Readable say "families", because here the word names whole nations, and "clans" would sound too small.

decisions.choice: two families, Israel and Judah
decisions.reason: Readable names the two families as Israel and Judah, following m1. This is the likeliest meaning, but not certain.

decisions.choice: The people's words about God take the honorific ("택하신", "버리셨다")
decisions.reason: The words are the people's, quoted by God, so they speak of God politely, as others do; God's own words around them stay plain.

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־לֹ֥א בְרִיתִ֖י יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה חֻקּ֛וֹת שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָ֖רֶץ לֹא־שָֽׂמְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: if not my covenant [with] daytime and night, [the] fixed laws of heavens and earth not I have set,

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: If [there is] not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with day and night, [if] I have not set the fixed laws of heaven and earth,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: If I had not made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with day and night, if I had not set in place the fixed laws of heaven and earth,
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I have made a covenant with day and night. I have set the laws that the sky and the earth must follow. They still stand.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Si no [existe] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con el día y la noche, [si] no he puesto las leyes fijas del cielo y de la tierra,
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Si yo no hubiera hecho {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con el día y la noche, si no hubiera establecido las leyes fijas del cielo y de la tierra,
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Yo hice un pacto con el día y la noche. Establecí las leyes que el cielo y la tierra deben seguir. Esas leyes siguen firmes.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Si {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec le jour et la nuit n’[existe] pas, [si] je n’ai pas établi les lois des cieux et de la terre,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Si je n’avais pas fait {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec le jour et la nuit, si je n’avais pas établi les lois fixes du ciel et de la terre,
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : J’ai fait une alliance avec le jour et la nuit. J’ai établi les lois que le ciel et la terre doivent suivre. Elles tiennent toujours.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kama [hakuna] agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na mchana na usiku, [kama] sikuziweka amri za mbingu na nchi,
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kama nisingefanya agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na mchana na usiku, kama nisingeziweka amri za kudumu za mbingu na nchi,
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nimefanya agano na mchana na usiku. Nimeweka sheria ambazo anga na dunia zinapaswa kufuata. Bado zinasimama.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Nếu [không có] giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với ngày và đêm, [nếu] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không đặt các luật định cho trời và đất,
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không lập giao ước với ngày và đêm, nếu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không đặt các luật định cho trời và đất,
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta đã lập giao ước với ngày và đêm. Ta đã đặt những luật mà trời và đất phải theo. Chúng vẫn còn đứng vững.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 낮과 밤과 맺은 내 언약이 없다면, 내가 하늘과 땅의 규례를 정하지 않았다면,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 낮과 밤과 언약을 맺지 않았다면, 내가 하늘과 땅의 법칙을 세우지 않았다면,
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 낮과 밤과 언약을 맺었다. 나는 하늘과 땅이 따라야 할 법칙을 세웠다. 그 언약과 법칙은 지금도 그대로 있다.

decisions.choice: if I have not made my covenant: another impossible condition
decisions.reason: As in verse 20. God has set day and night and the laws of heaven and earth in place; as surely as he has, he will keep his promise to his people (verse 26). The verb "set" stands at the end and serves both halves of the verse.

decisions.choice: the fixed laws of heaven and earth: the order God gave creation
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for statutes. In 31:35-36 God speaks of "the fixed laws" of moon and stars: only if they failed would Israel cease to be a nation. Compare Job 38:33.

decisions.choice: statements in place of the condition
decisions.reason: Readable states what God has done and adds "They still stand", so that verse 26 can draw the comparison plainly. The meaning of the oath-like condition is kept.

source.text: גַּם־זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקוֹב֩ וְדָוִ֨ד עַבְדִּ֜י אֶמְאַ֗ס מִקַּ֤חַת מִזַּרְעוֹ֙ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים אֶל־זֶ֥רַע אַבְרָהָ֖ם יִשְׂחָ֣ק וְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי־אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־שְׁבוּתָ֖ם וְרִחַמְתִּֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: also [the] offspring of Jacob and David my servant I will reject, from taking from his offspring rulers over [the] offspring of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; for I will turn back their fortunes and I will have compassion on them.

en.L: then also I would reject the offspring of Jacob and of David {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, so as not to take from his offspring rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes, and I will have compassion on them."
en.B: then I would also reject Jacob's descendants and those of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David, and not take rulers from David's line to govern the descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Indeed, I will restore their fortunes and have compassion on them."
en.R: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Jacob and of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David. I will always choose rulers from David's descendants to rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. I will make things good again for them, and I will have mercy on them."

es.L: también desecharía la descendencia de Jacob y de David {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, para no tomar de su descendencia gobernantes sobre la descendencia de Abraham, de Isaac y de Jacob. Porque yo restauraré su suerte, y tendré compasión de ellos».
es.B: entonces también desecharía a los descendientes de Jacob y a los de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David, y no tomaría gobernantes del linaje de David para que gobernaran a los descendientes de Abraham, Isaac y Jacob. Pero de cierto restauraré su suerte y tendré compasión de ellos».
es.R: De la misma manera, nunca desecharé a los descendientes de Jacob y de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David. Siempre escogeré gobernantes de entre los descendientes de David para que gobiernen a los descendientes de Abraham, Isaac y Jacob. Haré que todo vuelva a ir bien para ellos, y tendré misericordia de ellos».

fr.L: alors aussi je rejetterais la descendance de Jacob et de David, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, pour ne plus prendre de sa descendance des chefs pour la descendance d’Abraham, d’Isaac et de Jacob. Car je rétablirai leur sort, et j’aurai compassion d’eux. »
fr.B: alors je rejetterais aussi les descendants de Jacob et ceux de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David, et je ne prendrais plus dans la lignée de David des chefs pour gouverner les descendants d’Abraham, d’Isaac et de Jacob. Oui, je rétablirai leur sort et j’aurai compassion d’eux. »
fr.R: De la même manière, je ne rejetterai jamais les descendants de Jacob et de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David. Je choisirai toujours des chefs parmi les descendants de David pour gouverner les descendants d’Abraham, d’Isaac et de Jacob. Je les rendrai de nouveau heureux, et j’aurai pitié d’eux. »

sw.L: ndipo ningeukataa pia uzao wa Yakobo na wa Daudi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nisitwae katika uzao wake watawala juu ya uzao wa Abrahamu, Isaka na Yakobo. Kwa maana nitawarudishia mafanikio yao, nami nitawahurumia."
sw.B: ndipo ningewakataa pia wazao wa Yakobo na wa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi, nisitwae watawala kutoka ukoo wa Daudi kuwaongoza wazao wa Abrahamu, Isaka na Yakobo. Naam, nitawarudishia mafanikio yao na kuwahurumia."
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo sitawakataa kamwe wazao wa Yakobo na wa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi. Daima nitachagua watawala kutoka wazao wa Daudi watawale juu ya wazao wa Abrahamu, Isaka na Yakobo. Nitayafanya mambo kuwa mema tena kwao, nami nitawahurumia."

vi.L: thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ loại bỏ dòng dõi Gia-cốp và Đa-vít đầy tớ Ta, không chọn trong dòng dõi người những người cai trị dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác và Gia-cốp. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của họ và thương xót họ."
vi.B: thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mới loại bỏ dòng dõi Gia-cốp và dòng dõi Đa-vít đầy tớ Ta, và không chọn người trong dòng dõi Đa-vít để cai trị dòng dõi Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác và Gia-cốp. Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của họ và thương xót họ."
vi.R: Cũng vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ loại bỏ dòng dõi Gia-cốp và dòng dõi Đa-vít đầy tớ Ta. Ta sẽ luôn chọn những người trong dòng dõi Đa-vít để cai trị con cháu Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác và Gia-cốp. Ta sẽ làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại cho họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thương xót họ."

ko.L: 나도 야곱의 자손과 내 종 다윗의 자손을 버려서, 그의 자손 가운데서 아브라함과 이삭과 야곱의 자손을 다스릴 통치자들을 택하지 않을 것이다. 내가 그들의 운명을 돌이키고 그들을 불쌍히 여길 것이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 나도 야곱의 자손과 내 종 다윗의 자손을 버려서, 다윗의 자손 가운데서 아브라함과 이삭과 야곱의 자손을 다스릴 통치자들을 택하지 않을 것이다. 참으로 내가 그들의 형편을 회복시키고 그들을 불쌍히 여기겠다."
ko.R: 그처럼 나는 야곱의 자손과 내 종 다윗의 자손을 결코 버리지 않겠다. 나는 언제나 다윗의 자손 가운데서 통치자들을 택하여 아브라함과 이삭과 야곱의 자손을 다스리게 하겠다. 내가 그들을 다시 잘되게 해 주고, 그들에게 자비를 베풀겠다."

decisions.choice: then I would reject: the result of the impossible condition
decisions.reason: As in verse 21: since the laws of creation stand, God will not reject Jacob's descendants or David's, and he will go on taking rulers from David's line.

decisions.choice: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob: the promise to the fathers
decisions.reason: The rulers from David's line will rule over the people descended from the three fathers to whom God first made his covenant (Genesis 17:7; Exodus 2:24). The name Isaac is spelled here with a different letter, as in Amos 7:9, 16 and Psalm 105:9.

decisions.choice: restore their fortunes and have compassion: the promise of verse 7
decisions.reason: As in verse 7 and Deuteronomy 30:3, where the same two promises stand together. Compassion is the tender love of a parent for a child (31:20).

decisions.choice: I will restore: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has a slightly different form of the verb "restore" from the one the scribes noted in the margin to be read aloud. The meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: Indeed (B)
decisions.reason: The small word that begins the last clause can mean "for" or "surely". Balanced says "Indeed", since the clause says what God will do in place of rejecting his people. Readable leaves the word out and says "make things good again" as in verse 7.
